detail.abstract: The proliferation of generative artificial intelligence across text, image, audio, video, and code has outpaced the infrastructure required to verify the origin, integrity, and accountability of AI-generated content. Existing approaches-metadata manifests [1], post-hoc watermarking [2][3], and proprietary signal systems [4]each address a fragment of this problem but fail collectively on three critical dimensions: they operate after inference rather than during it, they cover only a subset of modalities, and they do not bind cryptographic identity with tamper-resistant content signals and encrypted provenance metadata in a single, atomic operation. This paper introduces the UACI Framework (Universal AI Content Identification System), a middleware architecture that resolves all three gaps simultaneously. UACI executes a single inference-time pipeline that atomically produces: (i) a BLAKE3-128 cryptographic content identifier via the UACI Protocol; (ii) an imperceptible, transformation-resilient watermark embedded by StealthResist using spread-spectrum DCT encoding with BCH(255,131,18) error correction [6]; and (iii) an AES-256-GCM encrypted provenance capsule-the P3 Capsule-that seals model identity, generation parameters, temporal metadata, and a verifiable UACI Framework-Working Paper | XWHYZ / WHYLD Research | 2 content hash, with per-asset key material derived via HKDF-SHA256 [12]. Orchestration is managed by the PAIR Router (Proof-of-Origin AI Router), with public verification exposed through the OpenVeri toolkit. Projected estimates based on component-level analysis indicate a total pipeline overhead of approximately 53-71 ms on commodity CPU hardware for 512×512 image outputs, consistent with published benchmarks for equivalent cryptographic and DCT-domain operations [7][13][14]. UACI is designed as a complementary layer to C2PA (ISO/IEC 22144) rather than a replacement. The framework is the first unified provenance architecture to bind code-modality watermarking to a cryptographic identifier and encrypted provenance vault within a single inference-time pipeline-a configuration absent from all current production platforms and prior published proposals [9][10].

AI.tldr: 本文提出UACI框架，一种在AI内容生成推理阶段同时完成加密内容标识、抗篡改水印嵌入和加密溯源封装的统一中间件架构，解决了现有方案在推理时操作缺失、模态覆盖不全、身份绑定不足三大核心问题。
AI.research_question: 如何在AI内容生成推理过程中，以一种原子化、跨模态、可验证的方式，同时实现内容来源认证、完整性保护和身份绑定？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI内容泛滥，但现有溯源方案（元数据清单、事后水印、专有信号系统）各自为政，均存在三个关键缺陷：仅在推理后操作、覆盖模态有限、无法将加密身份与防篡改内容信号及加密元数据在一个原子操作中绑定。
AI.theoretical_framework: UACI协议（BLAKE3-128加密内容标识）、StealthResist水印（扩频DCT编码+BCH纠错）、P3封装（AES-256-GCM加密溯源胶囊）、PAIR路由器（溯源路由编排）、OpenVeri公开验证工具包。设计理念是与C2PA（ISO/IEC 22144）互补而非替代。
AI.method: 中间件架构设计，在推理阶段执行单一流水线，原子化生成三项输出：加密内容标识、抗变换水印、加密溯源封装。基于组件级分析对512×512图像输出进行性能估算（约53-71ms）。
AI.findings: 该框架首次在单一推理时流水线中统一了三种功能：代码模态水印、加密标识符和加密溯源库。在普通CPU上处理512×512图像的预估总开销为53-71ms，与现有加密和DCT域操作的公开基准一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出推理时原子化统一溯源架构，填补了现有生产平台和学术提案中同时绑定加密身份、水印和加密溯源元数据的理论空白。框架设计为C2PA标准的互补层而非替代，具有标准化兼容性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供OpenVeri公开验证工具包和PAIR路由器，支持跨模态（文本、图像、音频、视频、代码）的AI内容来源验证；推理时水印嵌入具有抗变换鲁棒性；加密溯源胶囊保护模型身份、生成参数等敏感元数据；计算开销可控，适合实际部署。

title: Five Structural Properties of Trade AI: A Conceptual Framework for AI System Design in High-Stakes Cross-Border Commerce
affiliations: and Kookmin University

detail.title: Five Structural Properties of Trade AI: A Conceptual Framework for AI System Design in High-Stakes Cross-Border Commerce
detail.abstract: The strongest AI agent system evaluated on public benchmarks classifies products under the Harmonized System (HS) at the ten-digit level with 46.8% accuracy. The ten-digit code is the legal unit at which tariffs are levied, and human experts reach roughly 95% in the same evaluation. The gap persists across the strongest deployed systems and concentrates precisely on decisions that carry legal consequence. This paper argues that the explanation lies in structure, not in model immaturity. Because trustworthy-AI principles are deliberately domain-agnostic, trade requires a design framework specific to its own structure. To that end, we name and isolate five structural properties of Trade AI: uncertainty, ambiguity, risk, irreversibility, and asymmetry, as a single design set, and group them by where each arises in a trade decision: two originate in the act of judgment, two in the consequences that judgment produces, and one in the structural environment surrounding both. Six propositions (P1-P6) attach a testable design prescription to each property; every proposition is grounded in classical economic theory and carries a measurable operationalization. An asymmetry coordinate plane (r, d), defined by a jurisdiction's data-resource level and regulatory idiosyncrasy, serves as a hypothesis-generating device for locating where domain-specific adaptation becomes necessary. Taking Korea's field deployment as the primary validation case and adding crossjurisdictional benchmarks, workflow experiments, and multilingual bias measurements, we illustrate that the framework's properties and propositions surface consistently in existing results produced for unrelated purposes. The unified prescription is plain: a Trade AI system must be built to know what it does not know and to act differently where errors are irreversible, and both behaviors must be tuned to an asymmetric terrain that off-the-shelf models systematically misread. Generic capability does not transfer to trade decisions. What this domain demands is not more general intelligence but systems engineered to its structure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出贸易AI的五大结构属性（不确定性、模糊性、风险、不可逆性、不对称性），并以此构建设计框架，论证通用AI能力无法直接迁移至贸易决策领域，需要针对贸易结构进行系统工程化设计。
AI.research_question: 为什么最强的AI系统在HS编码分类任务上的准确率（46.8%）与人类专家（95%）存在巨大差距，且这一差距集中在具有法律后果的决策上？
AI.motivation: 现有AI基准测试显示贸易领域存在显著的"人机差距"，且可信任AI原则是领域无关的，无法直接指导贸易AI的设计，因此需要针对贸易决策的独特结构提出专门的设计框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经典经济理论，提炼出贸易AI的五大结构属性：不确定性（判断行为）、模糊性（判断行为）、风险（判断后果）、不可逆性（判断后果）、不对称性（结构性环境）。每个属性对应一个可检验的设计命题（P1-P6），并提出不对称性坐标平面（r, d）作为假设生成工具。
AI.method: 理论构建与多源实证验证：以韩国现场部署为主要验证案例，辅以跨辖区的基准测试、工作流实验和多语言偏差测量，检验框架属性和命题在已有结果中的一致性表现。
AI.findings: 贸易AI的五大结构属性在多种已有实证结果中一致显现；通用AI能力无法直接迁移至贸易决策；系统必须"知道自己不知道什么"并在错误不可逆时采取不同行动，且这些行为需要根据不对称地形进行调整。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地提出贸易AI的结构属性框架，将可信任AI的通用原则转化为贸易领域特定的可操作设计命题，并建立不对称性坐标平面作为理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为贸易AI系统的工程设计提供了明确的规范：系统需要具备不确定性感知、错误成本权衡和不对称适应性，而非追求更大的通用模型。

title: Large Language Models Explain Experts Better Than Experts Themselves
affiliations: , University of Minnesota - Twin Cities - Carlson School of Management, University of Minnesota and University of Minnesota - Twin Cities - Carlson School of Management

detail.title: Large Language Models Explain Experts Better Than Experts Themselves
detail.abstract: Tacit knowledge, or the "know-how" embedded in experience, is difficult to articulate, making its transfer a challenge in organizations. Tacit knowledge is hard to externalize (transform into explicit knowledge), and expertise is often poorly documented and lost when experts leave. This study examines whether LLMs can externalize tacit knowledge from experts' behaviors and whether such externalized knowledge supports downstream decision-making and transfer to novices. Across two studies, we show that LLM-externalized tacit knowledge improves decision quality and enables novices to approach expertlevel performance, often outperforming knowledge articulated by human experts. These findings provide empirical support for Polanyi's Paradox-that we can know more than we can tell-and highlight the potential of LLMs as scalable tools that can help overcome human experts' articulation bottleneck. Mechanism analyses and robustness checks show that LLMs meaningfully learn and extract knowledge from expert conversations, and findings generalize across models and retrieval methods.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨大型语言模型（LLMs）能否从专家行为中外化隐性知识（tacit knowledge），并支持下游决策和知识转移。两项研究表明，LLM外化的隐性知识能提升决策质量，使新手达到接近专家水平的绩效，甚至优于人类专家自己阐述的知识。这为波兰尼悖论（“我们知道的比能说出来的多”）提供了实证支持，并凸显LLMs作为可扩展工具、帮助克服人类专家“表达瓶颈”的潜力。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型能否从专家行为中外化隐性知识？这种外化的知识能否支持下游决策并转移给新手？
AI.motivation: 隐性知识难以表达和转移，专家离职时常导致知识流失。现有方法依赖人类专家自我阐述，但受限于“表达瓶颈”（articulation bottleneck）。因此，需要探索LLMs是否能够通过观察专家行为来外化他们无法言说的隐性知识。
AI.theoretical_framework: 波兰尼悖论（Polanyi's Paradox）：我们知道的比能说出来的多；隐性知识理论（Tacit Knowledge Theory）；知识外化与转移理论。
AI.method: 两项实证研究：1）比较LLM外化的隐性知识与人类专家自述知识对决策质量的影响；2）测试LLM外化知识对新手绩效提升的效果。包含机制分析和稳健性检验，跨模型和检索方法进行验证。
AI.findings: LLM外化的隐性知识显著提升决策质量，使新手接近专家水平绩效，且常优于人类专家自己阐述的知识。机制分析表明LLMs能从专家对话中有意义地学习和提取知识，结果跨模型和检索方法保持稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 为波兰尼悖论提供新的实证支持，证明LLMs可以外化人类专家无法言说的隐性知识，扩展了知识管理理论中关于知识外化的边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可扩展的隐性知识外化工具，帮助组织在专家离职前保留关键知识，提升新手培训效率，降低知识流失风险。

title: Certify or Be Exposed: Agentic Automotive AI Safety and the Exposure of the Global South Under a Fragmented Frontier

detail.title: Certify or Be Exposed: Agentic Automotive AI Safety and the Exposure of the Global South Under a Fragmented Frontier
detail.abstract: Safety is the organizing concern of automotive certification: a driving system reaches public roads only by demonstrating to an external authority that it is acceptably safe. That premise is under strain. Driving automation is advancing faster than the conformity machinery that governs it, while perception and planning increasingly rely on foundation models and large language models integrated by manufacturers that often cannot themselves demonstrate these components' safety. This paper argues that the problem is not only one of speed but of direction. As the build layer commoditizes and becomes agentic, the object submitted for conformity assessment becomes less certifiable because the reasoning of large language models cannot be verified and the assurance case required by certification bodies cannot be produced. The resulting gap is amplified by the fragmentation of frontier AI capability across geopolitical blocs, leaving manufacturers outside the dominant AI powers exposed both to certification barriers and to asymmetric cyber threats. The paper characterizes this dual exposure, examines its implications for the Global South, and outlines a sovereign assurance posture centered on certifiable behavioral safety envelopes as a partial response.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，随着大语言模型和基础模型被集成到自动驾驶系统中，传统的汽车安全认证机制面临根本性挑战。问题不仅是认证速度跟不上技术发展，更在于方向性错位：LLM的推理不可验证，导致认证机构所需的保证案例无法生成。这种差距因 AI 能力的地缘政治碎片化而加剧，使非主导 AI 大国的制造商面临认证壁垒和不对称网络威胁的双重暴露。文章提出以"可认证行为安全包络"作为主权保证姿态的应对策略。
AI.research_question: 大语言模型和基础模型融入自动驾驶系统后，传统的汽车安全认证机制面临何种根本性挑战？非AI主导大国的制造商面临哪些双重暴露？
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶技术（尤其是基于LLM和基础模型的感知与规划系统）发展速度远超现有认证机制，制造商自身甚至无法证明这些组件的安全性，这构成了汽车行业安全认证的范式危机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 安全认证理论、保证案例理论、地缘政治经济学、主权技术理论、行为安全包络理论
AI.method: 概念分析与理论论证，基于对现有认证体系、LLM可验证性问题和地缘政治格局的定性分析。
AI.findings: 问题本质不是速度问题，而是方向性问题；LLM推理不可验证导致保证案例无法生成；AI能力的地缘政治碎片化加剧了非主导AI大国制造商的认证壁垒和网络威胁双重暴露。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"可认证性"下降的新概念，界定了技术-制度-地缘政治三维交叉的认证危机，将安全认证问题与主权技术治理联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球南方和非AI主导大国的汽车制造商提出了"可认证行为安全包络"的应对策略，有助于指导这些国家建立主权保证姿态。

title: The Assurance Fabric: Institutional Preconditions for Trustworthy AI in Digital Public Infrastructure

detail.title: The Assurance Fabric: Institutional Preconditions for Trustworthy AI in Digital Public Infrastructure
detail.abstract: States increasingly deploy artificial intelligence on digital public infrastructure (DPI), from biometric identity verification to automated eligibility decisions. Most AI assurance debate concerns model properties. This paper asks a prior question: under what institutional conditions can DPI, and therefore the AI embedded in it, be trusted at all? We combine a documentary comparative study of fourteen national DPI trajectories with structured case coding and crisp-set qualitative comparative analysis. The evidence is anchored in auditinstitution, judicial and statutory sources. In this case set, three conditions are individually necessary but not sufficient for trajectory-level success: an accountable institutional owner, sustained platform funding, and published performance measurement. Under our baseline coding, the configuration of prior law with an accountable owner and sustained funding is consistent with success in every case exhibiting it (coverage 0.63). Aggregate e-government indices do not separate successes from failures in this sample (exact permutation p = 0.22, eight successes versus six failures). The United Kingdom and Australia sit in the global top ten while having closed or repeatedly restarted flagship identity programmes. A simple count of institutional conditions, by contrast, separates outcomes in this sample (exact permutation p = 0.004). We use both tests as descriptive contrasts within a purposive sample. We derive an assurance-fabric model in which enterprise-architecture functions supply the registries, mandates, investment gates and ownership that AI assurance frameworks take for granted. We also map five documented population-scale harms to concrete controls for AI-enabled DPI. Trustworthy AI in public infrastructure is an institutional achievement before it is a model property.

AI.tldr: 本文研究数字公共基础设施（DPI）及其嵌入的AI可信赖的制度条件。通过对14个国家DPI轨迹的比较研究，发现三个条件对制度层面成功是必要但不充分的：负责任的机构所有者、持续的平台资金支持和公开的绩效测量。提出了"保障面料模型"，认为可信赖的AI首先是制度成就，而非模型属性。
AI.research_question: 在何种制度条件下，数字公共基础设施（DPI）及其嵌入的AI可以被信赖？
AI.motivation: 当前AI保障的讨论主要聚焦于模型属性，而忽略了更根本的问题：DPI及其中AI运行所需的制度基础条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 保障面料模型（assurance-fabric model），认为企业架构职能提供AI保障框架所依赖的注册、授权、投资门控和所有权等基础。
AI.method: 对14个国家数字公共基础设施发展轨迹的文献比较研究，结合结构化案例编码和清晰集定性比较分析（csQCA）。证据基础包括审计机构、司法和法定来源。
AI.findings: 三个条件对制度层面成功是必要但不充分的：负责任的机构所有者、持续的平台资金支持、公开的绩效测量。三个条件的组合（优先法律+负责任的机构所有者+持续资金）始终与成功一致（覆盖度0.63）。简单制度条件计数能区分成功与失败（p=0.004），而综合电子政务指数不能区分（p=0.22）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"保障面料模型"，将AI可信赖问题从模型属性重新定义为制度成就，识别出AI保障框架所依赖的前置制度条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共部门AI部署提供制度层面的保障框架，映射了五种大规模伤害及其对应的具体控制措施，指导政策制定者关注制度基础而非仅模型性能。

detail.title: AI-Orchestrated Enterprise Integration Platforms for Intelligent Automation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This research was inspired by my professional experience as an Integration Manager leading enterprise-wide integration, API management, cloud modernization, and digital transformation initiatives. Working at the intersection of business processes, enterprise applications, cloud platforms, and operational governance provided unique insights into the limitations of traditional integration approaches and the growing demand for intelligent, AI-enabled orchestration capabilities. Through leading integration operations and driving innovation across enterprise integration ecosystems, the author observed how Artificial Intelligence and intelligent automation could transform conventional integration platforms into adaptive systems capable of autonomous workflow execution, predictive decision-making, intelligent API routing, real-time monitoring, and self-optimizing business processes. These practical experiences served as the primary motivation for investigating AI-Orchestrated Enterprise Integration Platforms and their role in enabling intelligent enterprise automation. The study reflects insights gained from modernizing integration architectures, implementing cloud-native solutions, enhancing API governance, improving operational resilience, and advancing automation strategies across large-scale enterprise environments. No external funding or sponsorship was received for this work, and the conclusions presented are solely those of the author and do not necessarily represent the views of any employer, client, or affiliated organization.

publicationDetails.detailsText: AI-Orchestrated Enterprise Integration Platforms for Intelligent Automation | Frontiers in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence

detail.abstract: The rapid growth of digital transformation has increased the demand for intelligent, scalable, and adaptive enterprise integration systems capable of connecting diverse applications, cloud services, APIs, and business processes. This paper explores the concept of AI-Orchestrated Enterprise Integration Platforms for Intelligent Automation, focusing on how Artificial Intelligence (AI) enhances enterprise interoperability, workflow optimization, and decision-making across modern organizations. Traditional integration platforms often rely on static configurations and manual process management, which limit flexibility and responsiveness in dynamic business environments. In contrast, AI-driven orchestration introduces intelligent automation capabilities such as predictive analytics, autonomous workflow execution, anomaly detection, intelligent API management, and real-time data synchronization. The study examines the integration of machine learning, natural language processing, robotic process automation (RPA), and cloud-native architectures within enterprise integration platforms to enable self-optimizing business ecosystems. It also highlights how AI-powered orchestration improves operational efficiency, reduces human intervention, enhances scalability, and accelerates digital innovation across industries including finance, healthcare, manufacturing, logistics, and e-commerce. Furthermore, the paper discusses key challenges such as data security, governance, interoperability, ethical AI adoption, and infrastructure complexity.By analyzing emerging trends and practical implementation strategies, this research demonstrates that AI-orchestrated integration platforms represent a transformative approach to intelligent enterprise automation, enabling organizations to build adaptive, resilient, and data-driven operational frameworks suitable for the evolving demands of Industry 4.0 and cloud computing environments.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了AI编排的企业集成平台如何通过智能自动化（预测分析、自主工作流执行、异常检测等）增强企业互操作性、优化工作流和决策能力，从而推动数字化转型。
AI.research_question: AI如何通过编排技术增强企业集成平台的互操作性、工作流优化和决策能力？
AI.motivation: 传统集成平台依赖静态配置和手动流程管理，难以适应动态商业环境，亟需引入AI驱动的智能自动化能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI编排理论、机器学习、自然语言处理、机器人流程自动化（RPA）、云原生架构、工业4.0与云计算理论。
AI.method: 文献综述与新兴趋势分析，结合跨行业（金融、医疗、制造、物流、电商）实践案例。
AI.findings: AI编排的集成平台能提升运营效率、减少人工干预、增强可扩展性、加速数字创新，但也面临数据安全、治理、互操作性、伦理AI及基础设施复杂性等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI编排企业集成平台的理论框架，将机器学习、NLP、RPA与云原生架构整合为自优化业务生态系统的概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融、医疗、制造、物流、电商等行业提供了AI驱动集成平台的实际部署策略，助力企业建设适应工业4.0和云计算环境的自适应、弹性运营框架。

title: Missing the Signs: Gender Bias in Charismatic Leadership Tactics
affiliations: University of New South Wales, University of New South Wales and University of New South Wales

detail.title: Missing the Signs: Gender Bias in Charismatic Leadership Tactics
detail.abstract: The leadership literature widely relies on the Charismatic Leadership Tactics (CLTs) as the dominant behavioral operationalization of leader charisma. Despite their prominence, the CLTs have not been systematically examined for completeness, and potential gender bias remains largely unexplored. This is problematic because the CLTs were originally developed and validated using predominantly male leader samples, raising questions regarding their coverage of behaviors more commonly enacted by women leaders. We adopt a mixed-method grounded theory approach across four study phases, which integrates insights from comparative literature analyses, an in-depth interview with 21 participants, and a large-scale experiment with 1,019 participants. Our experiment examines individual charisma signals across three digital communication modes. Our findings reveal critical omissions in the CLT taxonomy and identify four additional tactics: empathy, active positivity, transparency, and strong self-concept, two of which are nominally feminine. Experimental results show that the tactics significantly increase charisma attributions regardless of leader gender, with effects strongest in video, weaker in audio, and limited to a subset of tactics in text. We propose the neo-Charismatic Leadership Tactics as a more comprehensive and gender-inclusive behavioral taxonomy that advances understanding of how charisma is signaled, assessed, and interpreted across gender and clarifies important boundary conditions in charismatic leadership theory.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用混合方法 grounded theory，发现魅力型领导策略（CLTs）存在关键遗漏，识别出四种新策略（同理心、积极正向、透明、强自我概念），其中两种为女性化策略，并提出更具包容性的新魅力型领导策略（neo-CLTs）
AI.research_question: CLTs是否完整？是否存在性别偏见？如何扩展更具包容性的魅力领导行为分类？
AI.motivation: CLTs基于以男性为主的领导者样本开发和验证，可能遗漏了女性领导者更常使用的魅力行为，导致性别偏见。
AI.theoretical_framework: 魅力型领导理论、魅力型领导策略（CLTs）、性别角色理论、信号理论
AI.method: 混合方法扎根理论：四阶段研究，包括文献比较分析、21人深度访谈、1,019人大规模实验（跨视频/音频/文本三种数字沟通模式）
AI.findings: 发现四种遗漏策略（同理心、积极正向、透明、强自我概念），其中两个为女性化策略；新策略显著提升魅力归因，与领导者性别无关；视频效果最强，音频次之，文本效果最弱
AI.theory_contributions: 提出更全面且性别包容的neo-CLTs行为分类，推进对魅力信号跨性别传递、评估与解释的理解，阐明魅力领导理论的重要边界条件
AI.practical_contributions: 为领导者（尤其是女性领导者）提供更具包容性的魅力行为指导，帮助组织识别和培养多元化魅力领导力

title: The Deep Roots of Technology Industry Antiregulatory Strategy

detail.title: The Deep Roots of Technology Industry Antiregulatory Strategy
detail.abstract:
Many of the technology industry's antiregulatory strategies are built on a foundation first established by the petroleum industry a century ago and which has since proven quite effective. When leaded gasoline was first presented in the 1920s as a solution to a problem of engine performance and efficiency, there was significant concern about the use of lead, an element that had long been known to be a dangerous neurotoxin. Robert Kehoe, a physician and research scientist working on behalf of the lead industry, responded with an antiregulatory strategy that successfully protected the manufacture and sale of leaded gasoline for sixty years. 

Today, we are seeing the technology industry's implementation of its own antiregulatory Kehoe strategy, especially evident in the context of privacy. This privacy Kehoe strategy uses a two-pronged approach of framing devices and weighted cost-benefit arguments to block potential regulation. To push back against such a privacy Kehoe strategy, this Article recommends three approaches: continuing to build and expand a consensus around privacy harms, challenging the tendency toward privacy nihilism that is encouraged by the technology industry, and maintaining a healthy degree of skepticism with respect to technology industry claims regarding the costs of privacy regulation.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了科技行业借鉴石油行业的反监管策略（Kehoe策略），尤其是在隐私领域，通过框架设计和加权成本-收益论证来阻碍监管。作者提出三种应对方法：建立隐私危害共识、挑战隐私虚无主义、对科技行业的监管成本说法保持怀疑。
AI.research_question: 科技行业如何借鉴石油行业的反监管策略来阻碍隐私监管，以及如何有效应对这种策略？
AI.motivation: 科技行业正系统性地采用历史上石油行业的反监管策略，在隐私领域阻碍监管，需要识别这种策略模式并提出应对方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: Kehoe反监管策略理论：通过框架设计（framing devices）和加权成本-收益论证（weighted cost-benefit arguments）的双管齐下方式，以科学或经济论据包装，实质上阻碍合理监管。
AI.method: 历史比较分析法：通过追溯1920年代石油行业含铅汽油案例，与当代科技行业隐私监管策略进行跨时代对比分析。
AI.findings: 1. 科技行业的隐私Kehoe策略与石油行业策略高度相似；2. 该策略通过双管齐下（框架+成本收益论证）有效阻碍了监管；3. 应对策略需从共识建设、挑战虚无主义、保持怀疑三方面入手。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将Kehoe策略概念系统性地引入隐私监管领域，揭示了反监管策略跨行业的可移植性和历史延续性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和倡导者提供了识别和应对科技行业反监管策略的具体行动框架，帮助推动更有效的隐私保护监管。

title: Ergonomic Design and Evaluation of an Operation Table Using the Rapid Upper Limb Assessment (RULA) Method
affiliations: Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember, Sepuluh Nopember Institute of Technology, Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Ergonomic Design and Evaluation of an Operation Table Using the Rapid Upper Limb Assessment (RULA) Method
detail.abstract: Operating tables should facilitate safe patient positioning and support suitable working postures for medical personnel of different body sizes. This study developed an adjustable operating table with ergonomic assessment, structural verification and stability testing. The table was 2.0 m in length, 0.7 m in width and had an electrically actuated height range of 75–105 cm, controlled by push buttons. It was mainly structured from Al 6061-T aluminum alloy. The ergonomic performance was evaluated based on the Rapid Upper Limb Assessment (RULA) method using CATIA V5. Stability was assessed at loads of 0, 20, 40, 60.5, 82.7, and 100 kg and table heights from 75 to 105 cm with three repetitions per condition and response surface analysis. Verifying structure under 120 kg load showed maximum von Mises stress to be 14.6 MPa, well below allowable stress of 179 MPa. The most stable condition predicted was at 75 cm and 0 kg with pitch, roll and translational deviation values of 0.518°, 0.773° and 2.066 mm, respectively. The least stable condition was 105 cm and 86.76 kg with corresponding values of 2.305°, 3.311° and 5.340 mm respectively. The most important factor for stability was the loading condition. The RULA scores ranged from 3 to 4 and a table height of 85–90 cm gave the best compromise between ergonomic suitability and mechanical stability. The present results confirm the structural safety, mechanical stability and ergonomic acceptability of the proposed table in the recommended operating range.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一款高度可调（75-105厘米）的电动手术台，采用Al 6061-T铝合金制造，通过RULA方法评估人体工学、有限元分析验证结构强度，并测试了不同载荷（0-100kg）和高度下的稳定性。结果表明，在85-90cm高度范围内，手术台在人体工学适宜性与机械稳定性之间取得最佳平衡，结构安全可靠。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一款兼顾不同体型的医护人员工作姿势适宜性和患者安全定位的电动可调手术台，并验证其人体工学性能、结构安全性与机械稳定性？
AI.motivation: 手术台需要满足患者安全定位和不同体型医护人员工作姿势的双重需求，但现有研究缺乏对可调手术台进行系统的人体工学评估、结构验证和稳定性测试的整合性研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 快速上肢评估（RULA）方法；有限元分析（von Mises应力准则）；响应面分析法。
AI.method: 1) 使用CATIA V5软件基于RULA方法进行人体工学评估；2) 通过有限元分析验证120kg载荷下的结构强度；3) 在6种载荷（0、20、40、60.5、82.7、100kg）和不同高度（75-105cm）条件下进行稳定性测试，每条件重复3次，采用响应面分析。
AI.findings: 1) 最大von Mises应力14.6MPa远低于允许应力179MPa，结构安全；2) 最稳定条件：75cm、0kg（俯仰0.518°，滚转0.773°，平移2.066mm）；3) 最不稳定条件：105cm、86.76kg（俯仰2.305°，滚转3.311°，平移5.340mm）；4) 载荷是影响稳定性的最重要因素；5) RULA评分3-4分，85-90cm高度为人体工学与稳定性最佳折中区间。
AI.theory_contributions: 将RULA人体工学评估方法与响应面稳定性分析系统整合应用于手术台设计验证，为可调式医疗设备的综合性能评估提供了方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了一款结构安全、机械稳定且人体工学可接受的电控可调手术台，并确定了最佳工作高度范围（85-90cm），为手术室设备的人性化设计提供了工程参考。

title: Autonomous Productive Activity as a Distinct Factor of Production: The L-A-K-N Theoretical Model
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Autonomous Productive Activity as a Distinct Factor of Production: The L-A-K-N Theoretical Model
detail.abstract: This paper proposes the L-A-K-N theoretical model, which distinguishes two analytically different dimensions of production: the activity dimension and the material-enabling dimension. Human productive activity (L) and autonomous productive activity (A) describe the direct execution of productive functions, whereas produced capital (K) and natural/material resources (N) constitute the enabling base of production. The central argument is that a robot, automated machine, software system, or artificial intelligence model is a capital asset, while the productive activity autonomously performed by that asset is not identical to the asset itself. The paper develops four criteria for the analytical distinctiveness of A, distinguishes A from capital services, technology, and multifactor productivity, and relates the model to task-based economics. The proposed category is not presented as a replacement for conventional capital measurement, but as an additional functional axis for analyzing the changing identity of the direct executor of productive tasks. The model provides the conceptual foundation for subsequent task-level measurement of autonomous productive activity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出L-A-K-N理论模型，将生产区分为活动维度（人类劳动L与自主生产活动A）和物质使能维度（生产资本K与自然资源N），核心论点是自动化资产与其执行的自主生产活动并非同一事物。
AI.research_question: 如何从理论上区分资本资产（如机器人、AI模型）与其所执行的自主生产活动，并建立独立的分析范畴？
AI.motivation: 现有经济学框架常将自动化设备与设备执行的生产活动混为一谈，忽略了自主生产活动（A）作为独立分析维度的必要性，导致对生产方式变迁的理解不充分。
AI.theoretical_framework: L-A-K-N模型：活动维度（L人类劳动、A自主生产活动）与物质使能维度（K生产资本、N自然资源），以及A的四项判别标准、A与资本服务/技术/全要素生产率的区分、与任务基础经济学的关联。
AI.method: 理论建模，提出分析框架和判别标准，概念辨析（与资本服务、技术、全要素生产率等既有概念的关系），并与任务基础经济学进行理论对接。
AI.findings: A是具有分析独立性的范畴，不应被还原为资本服务、技术或全要素生产率；该范畴不是替代传统资本测量，而是增加一个分析自主生产任务直接执行者身份变化的功能轴。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了L-A-K-N四维生产理论模型，建立了自主生产活动（A）的独立分析范畴及其判别标准，为任务层面的自主生产活动测量提供了概念基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为后续任务层面的自主生产活动测量提供概念基础，有助于更准确分析自动化和AI对生产方式、就业和经济结构的影响。

title: Filtering The Labor Pool: How Digitalization Redistributes Hiring Costs

detail.title: Filtering The Labor Pool: How Digitalization Redistributes Hiring Costs
detail.abstract: I theorize that candidate filters, a core technology in digital labor markets considered central to cost-effective matching, redistributes costs from the search-and-screening stage to the job-offer stage of hiring. Filters cause employers to focus on applicants who display common preferred characteristics. At the search-and-screening stage, filters reduce the number of applicants interviewed and alter the composition of the interviewed pool by removing both lowerand higher-quality candidates. At the job-offer stage, filters lead employers to make job offers to candidates with easily observable signals of quality and higher wage demands. Additionally, I theorize that if many firms target the same signals of quality, they may all pursue similar candidates. This increases bargaining power for those applicants, leading to more rejected job offers and higher wage demands. A randomized field experiment in a large online labor market confirms that filters redistribute hiring costs. The experiment shows that employers with access to filters interview 3.4% fewer applicants. Using a machine learning algorithm to proxy for unobservable-to-the-employer applicant quality, I show that filters cause employers to interview 28.9% fewer lower-quality applicants and 36.9% fewer high-quality applicants per job. Among employers who actively used filters, I find suggestive evidence of worse job-offer outcomes: offers are 8.9% more likely to be rejected, and contracted wages are 2.5% higher. I discuss the implications of this cost redistribution for organizations, labor markets, and strategy research.

AI.tldr: 本文研究数字劳动力市场中的候选人筛选技术如何将招聘成本从搜索筛选阶段重新分配至工作邀请阶段。通过随机田野实验发现，筛选技术减少了面试人数（3.4%），同时筛除了低质量（28.9%）和高质量（36.9%）候选人；此外，使用筛选技术的雇主面临更高的工作邀请拒绝率（8.9%）和更高的签约工资（2.5%）。
AI.research_question: 数字劳动力市场中的候选人筛选技术如何影响招聘过程中的成本分配？
AI.motivation: 尽管筛选技术被广泛认为是提高匹配效率的核心工具，但其对招聘全流程成本分配的影响尚未得到系统研究，尤其是可能产生的意外后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成本重新分配理论：筛选技术将成本从搜索筛选阶段转移至工作邀请阶段；信号追逐与议价能力理论：当多家企业追逐相同信号时，目标候选人议价能力提升。
AI.method: 随机田野实验（大型在线劳动力市场），结合机器学习算法代理雇主不可观测的候选人质量。
AI.findings: （1）筛选技术使面试人数减少3.4%；（2）低质量候选人面试减少28.9%，高质量候选人面试减少36.9%；（3）使用筛选技术的雇主工作邀请拒绝率增加8.9%；（4）签约工资提高2.5%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并验证了筛选技术的成本重新分配理论，揭示了技术看似高效但可能带来隐性成本；拓展了信号理论在劳动力市场中的应用，解释了为何同质化信号追逐会导致议价权转移。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒组织在使用筛选技术时需权衡筛选阶段的效率提升与邀请阶段的成本增加；对劳动力市场政策制定者和平台设计者具有启示意义，需关注技术可能加剧的人才争夺和工资通胀。

title: The Impact of FinTech Adoption on Financial Inclusion: A Global Assessment of Access, Outcomes, and Emerging Risks
affiliations: GLS University

detail.title: The Impact of FinTech Adoption on Financial Inclusion: A Global Assessment of Access, Outcomes, and Emerging Risks

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known financial interests, personal relationships, or competing interests that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study as it is based exclusively on publicly available secondary data and published literature. No human participants, personal data, or identifiable information were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant, funding, or financial support from any public, commercial, or not-for-profit organization.

detail.abstract: Financial technologies (FinTech) have emerged as one of the major factors changing financial service accessibility in the world today. This paper analyses the effect of mobile money, payment apps, and banking app adoption on financial inclusion in both developed and developing countries between 2011 and 2025. Based on World Bank's Global Findex Database 2025, GSMA Mobile Money Industry Reports, and national case studies of India and Sub-Saharan Africa, it was found that the global account ownership rate grew from 51% of adults in 2011 to 79% of people in 2024, with the largest growth being experienced by low-and middle-income economies through mobile-based accounts instead of nonexistent banking infrastructure. The results indicate the positive relationship between FinTech adoption and formal savings, digitized payments, and financial shock resilience, especially for women, rural population, and the population that was not engaged in banking activities before. At the same time, certain barriers persisting include 1.3 billion of unbanked adults located in only eight countries, financial confidence deficiency leading to dependency on help of others for account management, regulatory issues, and vulnerability to cyber fraud and over-indebtedness. The paper thus demonstrates that FinTech is a necessity but not a sufficiency for inclusive finance; it only works when it goes hand-inhand with infrastructure development, regulatory consumer protection, and financial literacy programs.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2011至2025年间移动货币、支付应用和银行应用的采用对发达国家和发展中国家金融包容性的影响，发现FinTech显著提升了全球账户拥有率（从51%增至79%），但仍面临14亿无银行账户人口、金融素养不足、监管问题和网络安全风险等挑战，认为FinTech需与基础设施、监管保护及金融教育协同才能实现包容性金融。
AI.research_question: 移动货币、支付应用和银行应用的采用如何影响发达国家和发展中国家的金融包容性？
AI.motivation: 金融科技正在改变全球金融服务可及性，但对其在不同经济发展水平国家中推动金融包容性的实际效果、作用机制及局限性缺乏系统性的跨国实证分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融包容性理论；技术采纳与扩散理论；数字金融发展理论
AI.method: 基于世界银行Global Findex数据库（2025）、GSMA移动货币行业报告，并结合印度和撒哈拉以南非洲国家的案例研究进行跨国实证分析。
AI.findings: （1）全球账户拥有率从2011年的51%增长至2024年的79%，中低收入经济体增长最快；（2）FinTech与正规储蓄、数字化支付和金融抗风险能力呈正相关，对女性、农村人口和未银行化人群尤为显著；（3）仍存在14亿无银行账户成年人集中在8个国家、金融自信缺乏、监管问题、网络欺诈和过度负债等障碍。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了FinTech对金融包容性的促进作用及其边界条件，论证了FinTech是包容性金融的必要但非充分条件，需要基础设施、监管保护和金融素养的协同配合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了FinTech推动金融包容性的实证证据和关键制约因素，建议配套基础设施发展、消费者保护法规和金融教育项目。

title:
Shallow and Deep 
A Theory of Competitive Advantage in the AI Economy

detail.title:
Shallow and Deep 
A Theory of Competitive Advantage in the AI Economy
detail.abstract: What endures in the AI economy? Disruption is moving at breathtaking speed, and the disruptors are being disrupted in turn. AI application companies that were built on rented frontier model intelligence were compressed fastest. But even the frontier laboratories, whose capital investments and advanced model performance seemed to be inimitable assets are witnessing open-weight rivals from China close the gap in months while their largest customers route around their pricing. The question of sustainable competitive advantage is urgent because nothing appears to sustain. This paper argues that the classical theories of advantage, positioning, the resource-based view, dynamic capabilities, and platform economics cannot explain the dynamics of competitive advantage in the AI economy because they were not built for a regime in which every competitor's core technology is rented, identical, and improving on someone else's schedule, and in which the substrate's advance can strand complementary assets without ever imitating them. The paper develops the needed theory. Depth, defined as the accumulated stock of co-specialized complementary assets in four classes, data capital, encoded expertise, workflow embedment, and trust assets, is what converts rented intelligence into defensible economic value. Six propositions specify how depth accumulates, why it resists imitation under identical model access, and when it decays, each with a falsification condition. A seven-dimension Depth Diagnostic operationalizes the theory, demonstrated through in-depth case studies and bounded by the conditions under which even proprietary assets strand. The theory explains the strategies of frontier laboratories themselves, who are migrating from selling capability to owning depth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"深度"（Depth）理论，解释在AI经济中，企业如何通过积累四种互补性资产（数据资本、编码专长、工作流嵌入、信任资产），将租赁来的通用AI智能转化为可持续的竞争优势。
AI.research_question: 在AI经济中，当所有竞争对手的核心技术都是租赁而来、同质且由他人决定升级节奏时，什么因素能够带来可持续的竞争优势？
AI.motivation: 经典竞争优势理论（定位学派、资源基础观、动态能力、平台经济学）无法解释AI经济中"一切似乎都无法持续"的独特竞争动态，亟需新理论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 深度理论（Depth Theory）：企业积累的四种协同专有互补性资产（数据资本、编码专长、工作流嵌入、信任资产）可将租赁的通用智能转化为可防御的经济价值。
AI.method: 理论构建+六个命题（含可证伪条件）+七维度深度诊断工具（Depth Diagnostic）+深度案例研究。
AI.findings: 前沿实验室正从"出售能力"转向"拥有深度"；即使模型本身趋同，通过深度积累仍可建立防御性优势；但即使专有资产也可能陷入困境，存在边界条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了适用于"核心技术同质可租赁"时代的全新竞争优势理论，拓展了互补性资产理论，并提供了可操作化的诊断框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI企业（应用层和基础模型层）提供了明确的战略指南：构建深度而非依赖模型本身；为投资者提供了评估AI企业可持续性的分析框架。
