title: Advice Taking Across Social Class: Why (and When) High-SES Consumers are More Likely to Take Advice from Marketplace Agents
affiliations: and University of Iowa

detail.title: Advice Taking Across Social Class: Why (and When) High-SES Consumers are More Likely to Take Advice from Marketplace Agents

publicationDetails.detailsText: Accepted for publication in the Journal of Consumer Psychology

detail.abstract: The present research investigates whether consumers of low or high socioeconomic status (SES) are more likely to take advice from marketplace agents. Across five studies (and an additional three in the Methodological Details Appendix), including an analysis of the World Values Survey, and across a range of different advice taking contexts, we find that high-SES consumers are more likely to take the advice of marketplace agents compared to low-SES consumers. We demonstrate that this is due to differences in the sources through which high and low-SES consumers form judgments of trustworthiness, leading high-SES consumers to perceive advisors as generally more trustworthy, increasing the likelihood that they take their advice. However, these differences are attenuated under two conditions: First, when providing an external trustworthiness cue, differences in advice taking between low- and high-SES consumers are reduced. Second, shifting attention away from the agent and toward one’s own product needs and preferences attenuates the effect. This work makes important theoretical contributions regarding how low- and high-SES consumers differ in their propensity to take advice and carries important consumer well-being implications, particularly for the low-SES consumer.

AI.tldr: 高社会经济地位（SES）消费者比低SES消费者更倾向于采纳市场中介的建议，原因在于两者形成信任判断的来源不同，高SES消费者通常认为建议者更值得信任。当提供外部信任线索或将消费者注意力从建议者转移到自身产品需求时，这种差异会减弱。
AI.research_question: 高低社会经济地位（SES）消费者谁更倾向于采纳市场中介的建议？其背后的心理机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 不同社会经济地位的消费者在消费决策中对市场建议的采纳程度存在差异，已有研究对两者如何、为何以及在何种条件下表现出不同的建议采纳行为尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信任判断的源差异理论：高SES消费者倾向于基于对建议者的一般性信任形成判断，而低SES消费者更依赖情境线索。
AI.method: 五项主研究（及额外三项附录研究），包括世界价值观调查数据分析，跨多种建议采纳情境。
AI.findings: 高SES消费者比低SES消费者更倾向于采纳市场中介的建议。原因是高SES消费者感知建议者更值得信任。当提供外部信任线索或将注意力从建议者转移到自身产品需求时，差异减弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了高低SES消费者在建议采纳倾向上的差异及其背后的信任判断机制，拓展了消费者决策与社会阶层交叉领域的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 对低SES消费者的消费福祉有重要启示，提示可通过提供外部信任线索或引导其聚焦于自身需求来改善其建议采纳行为。

title: Anchors and Instability: Exchange Rate Regimes and Macroeconomic Volatility in the Advanced Economies since Bretton Woods
affiliations: Catholic University of Brasilia and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Anchors and Instability: Exchange Rate Regimes and Macroeconomic Volatility in the Advanced Economies since Bretton Woods
detail.abstract: Does the exchange rate regime independently affect inflation and output volatility, a dispute historical case studies alone cannot settle since regime choice is rarely random? This paper reopens the question using the de facto classification of Ilzetzki, Reinhart and Rogoff, merged with the Jordà-Schularick-Taylor Macrohistory Database for eighteen advanced economies, 1947–2019. Using two-way fixed-effects panels, quantile regressions, an event study around de facto peg exits, a dynamic persistence model, and six robustness checks, we find that countries under a de facto fixed or pegged regime exhibit systematically lower inflation volatility than floating regimes, an effect that persists, without fading to zero, once the sample moves from the cooperative, capital-controlled Bretton Woods system into the market-tested peg choices of the subsequent float era, contradicting the view that credible pegs were merely a byproduct of a cooperative international system, even though the peg’s disciplining power over inflation appears strongest of all during Bretton Woods itself. The relationship with output growth volatility is weaker, consistent with trilemma logic. An event study around the sample’s 17 de facto peg exits shows no significant pre-trend or post-exit deterioration in inflation volatility, suggesting regime switches often followed already-changing conditions, and two further tests, a broad-money volatility outcome not mechanically tied to the exchange rate path and a specification that directly controls for inflation volatility, address the concern that the inflation and output results are artifacts of the mechanical link between a stable exchange rate and the precision with which import prices and deflated output are measured. These findings speak to the historiography of the gold standard, Bretton Woods, and the European Monetary System, and to contemporary debates over hard pegs and monetary unions in emerging markets.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1947-2019年18个发达经济体的数据，通过多种实证方法发现：事实固定汇率制度能系统性地降低通胀波动性，这一效应在布雷顿森林体系解体后依然存在；但对产出波动的抑制效果较弱，符合"三元悖论"逻辑。事件研究还表明，汇率制度退出往往是对已有条件变化的响应，而非制度本身导致波动恶化的原因。
AI.research_question: 汇率制度是否独立影响通胀波动性和产出波动性？
AI.motivation: 历史案例研究无法解决汇率制度选择的非随机性问题，需要更严谨的实证方法重新审视这一经典问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三元悖论（Trilemma）、汇率制度分类理论（de facto classification）、固定汇率纪律效应（disciplining effect）
AI.method: 双向固定效应面板模型、分位数回归、事实盯住汇率退出的事件研究、动态持久性模型、六项稳健性检验
AI.findings: 1. 事实固定/盯住汇率制度下通胀波动性系统性低于浮动汇率制度，该效应在布雷顿森林体系后的浮动汇率时代依然存在；2. 对产出增长波动性的影响较弱，符合三元悖论逻辑；3. 17次事实盯住退出的事件研究显示，通胀波动性在退出前后无显著恶化趋势，表明制度切换往往是对已有条件变化的响应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 反驳了"可信盯住只是国际合作体系的副产品"这一观点，证明盯住汇率在合作体系解体后仍具有独立抑制通胀波动的能力；2. 为三元悖论提供了新的实证证据；3. 对金本位、布雷顿森林体系及欧洲货币体系的历史学术研究具有重要启示。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为新兴市场国家关于硬盯住和货币联盟的当代政策辩论提供实证参考；2. 揭示了汇率制度选择对宏观经济稳定性的独立影响，对央行和财政当局的政策设计具有指导意义。

title: Work from home, location choice and commuting behaviour: empirical evidence from Dutch cities
affiliations: Utrecht University, Utrecht University, Utrecht University and Utrecht University - Department of Economic Geography

detail.title: Work from home, location choice and commuting behaviour: empirical evidence from Dutch cities
detail.abstract: This paper investigates whether the widespread adoption of working from home (WfH) has weakened the role of proximity to the urban labour market in shaping residential location choices. We combine tax register and resident register data for the Netherlands in the period 2017--2024, allowing us to study a large share of employees holding a job on the urban labour market. To identify the effect of WfH we use quasi-experimental variation in who can WfH, stemming from the COVID-19 pandemic. We find that as a consequence of WfH the work-home travel time increased, and workers commuted into the city from more affordable and less densely populated areas. We find that these outcomes reflect both sorting of workers into residences farther from their job as well as into jobs farther from their residence. The effect of WfH is particularly pronounced for women, especially those with young children, and for early-career workers.

AI.tldr: 利用荷兰2017-2024年税收和居民登记数据，借助COVID-19疫情带来的准自然实验，研究发现居家办公（WfH）的普及显著削弱了城市劳动力市场邻近性对居住选址的作用，表现为通勤时间增加、工人从更便宜和人口密度更低的地区通勤进城，且这一效应在女性（尤其有幼儿者）和职业早期工作者中更为明显。
AI.research_question: 居家办公的广泛普及是否削弱了城市劳动力市场邻近性对居住选址决策的影响？
AI.motivation: COVID-19疫情后居家办公常态化，传统城市经济理论强调的"工作-居住邻近性"是否仍然成立，对城市空间结构和住房政策有重要启示。
AI.theoretical_framework: 城市经济学中的通勤成本与居住选址理论、空间匹配理论
AI.method: 利用荷兰2017-2024年税收登记与居民登记面板数据，采用基于COVID-19疫情带来的准实验变异（谁可以居家办公的外生变化）进行因果识别。
AI.findings: （1）居家办公导致工作-住所通勤时间增加；（2）工人从更便宜、人口密度更低的地区通勤进城；（3）这一结果既反映工人选择离工作更远的住所，也反映选择离住所更远的工作；（4）效应在女性（尤其有幼儿者）和职业早期工作者中更为显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 为后疫情时代城市空间结构理论提供实证证据，修正传统城市经济学中通勤成本与居住选址关系的假设，揭示居家办公对空间匹配机制的重塑作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市住房政策、交通规划和企业远程办公政策制定提供依据，提示应关注居家办公对不同人群（性别、职业阶段）的差异化影响。

title: Costly Talk: Effect of Presidential Speeches on Asset Prices
affiliations: University of Notre Dame

detail.title: Costly Talk: Effect of Presidential Speeches on Asset Prices
detail.abstract: Informal political communication by executive leaders increasingly shapes public discourse, yet its asset-pricing effects remain understudied. I identify 18 episodes in which Brazilian president Lula da Silva publicly criticized the central bank chair and timestamp the minute of each critique. Using five-minute data on the stock exchange index and the Brazilian real–US dollar exchange rate, I find that repricing began immediately after each event and stabilized within approximately 30 minutes. The effects are concentrated in early episodes and diminished over time, consistent with market learning about the informational content of repeated remarks. The adjustment occurred at the moment of each comment rather than upon its subsequent publication in the news.

AI.tldr: 本文利用巴西总统卢拉公开批评央行行长的18个事件，结合5分钟高频数据，发现此类非正式政治沟通会立即引发金融市场重新定价（约30分钟内稳定），且效果随着市场学习逐渐减弱，调整发生在发言时刻而非新闻发布时。
AI.research_question: 行政领导人的非正式政治沟通如何影响资产定价？
AI.motivation: 现有文献较少关注行政领导人非正式政治沟通对资产定价的影响，本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场学习理论；非正式政治沟通的信息含量理论。
AI.method: 事件研究法，利用5分钟高频股票指数和汇率数据，识别18次卢拉批评央行行长的精确事件时间戳。
AI.findings: 1) 事件发生后立即出现重新定价，约30分钟内稳定；2) 早期事件效果更显著，后期逐渐减弱（市场学习效应）；3) 价格调整发生在发言时刻，而非新闻发布时。
AI.theory_contributions: 将非正式政治沟通纳入资产定价分析框架；揭示市场学习机制如何调节政治沟通对金融市场的冲击。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示投资者关注领导人非正式言论的即时影响；为政策制定者提供关于政治沟通市场效应的证据。

title: Axis-Aligned Segment Encoding for Coronary Stenosis Grading in CCTA Images
affiliations: Hebei University, Hebei University, Hebei University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Hebei University

detail.title: Axis-Aligned Segment Encoding for Coronary Stenosis Grading in CCTA Images
detail.abstract: Coronary CT angiography (CCTA) is the first-line imaging modality for screening coronary artery disease and assessing stenosis; however, CCTA data sets are massive, and manual interpretation is time-consuming and lacks consistency. Existing deep learning methods treat curved surface reconstruction (CPR) images as ordinary two-dimensional images, lacking explicit encoding of positional information along the longitudinal axis of the vessel.This paper proposes an axis-aligned segment encoding module that partitions feature maps along the horizontal direction and learns an independent, adjustable weight for each partition, thereby implicitly encoding positional information along the horizontal direction of the feature maps. The module introduces only four learnable parameters and employs a direction-agnostic design, making it compatible with data augmentation strategies such as 90° rotation.On a clinical dataset comprising 6,864 CPR images, this module improved the accuracy of the baseline EfficientNetV2-S from 86.15% to 88.70%, with macro-average F1 and Kappa coefficients reaching 0.8695 and 0.8527, respectively.Compared with existing methods such as AFPE, RoPE, GPE, and PV-SSM-PE, this method outperforms them in both the number of parameters and classification accuracy.Bootstrap stability analysis shows an average accuracy of 88.78% with a standard deviation of only 0.0073. The learned weights exhibit a trend of suppression on the left and enhancement on the right, indicating that the model can adaptively learn data-driven spatial preferences. This module is lightweight, plug-and-play, and transferable to other medical image analysis tasks involving tubular structures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种轴向对齐的段编码模块，通过沿水平方向划分特征图并为每个分区学习独立可调权重，隐式编码血管纵轴位置信息。该模块仅引入4个可学习参数，在6864张CPR图像上将EfficientNetV2-S的准确率从86.15%提升至88.70%，宏平均F1达0.8695，Kappa系数0.8527，优于现有位置编码方法。
AI.research_question: 如何在不显著增加参数量的前提下，在CCTA的曲面重建（CPR）图像分类中有效编码血管纵轴的位置信息？
AI.motivation: CCTA数据量大，人工判读耗时且不一致；现有深度学习方法将CPR图像当作普通二维图像处理，缺乏沿血管纵轴方向的位置信息显式编码，导致分类性能受限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 位置编码理论；轴向分割编码思想；可学习分段权重机制。
AI.method: 提出轴向对齐段编码（Axis-aligned Segment Encoding）模块：沿特征图水平方向分区，为每个分区学习一个独立可调权重，从而隐式编码水平方向的位置信息。模块仅4个可学习参数，采用方向无关设计以兼容90°旋转等数据增强策略。基于EfficientNetV2-S基线模型进行实验。
AI.findings: 临床数据集6864张CPR图像上，该方法将基线准确率从86.15%提升至88.70%；宏平均F1为0.8695，Kappa系数0.8527；参数数量和分类精度均优于AFPE、RoPE、GPE、PV-SSM-PE等方法；Bootstrap稳定性分析显示平均准确率88.78%，标准差仅0.0073；学习到的权重呈现左抑制右增强的趋势，表明模型可自适应学习数据驱动的空间偏好。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种轻量级可学习的隐式位置编码方法，将轴向位置信息以分段权重方式融入特征图，为CPR图像的位置编码提供了新思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 该模块仅4个参数、即插即用，可显著提升CCTA CPR图像分类准确率，并具有可迁移性，适用于其他涉及管状结构的医学图像分析任务。

title: Adaptive Graph-Temporal Learning for Cardiovascular Risk Prediction and ECGDiagnostic Classification
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Deakin University and Deakin University

detail.title: Adaptive Graph-Temporal Learning for Cardiovascular Risk Prediction and ECGDiagnostic Classification
detail.abstract: Early detection of cardiovascular disease is critical for timely clinical intervention. Leveraging the increasing availability of Electronic Health Records (EHRs) and physiological signals, recent advances in deep learning have shown promise in predictive modeling; however, existing approaches often struggle to jointly capture structural feature interdependencies and long-range temporal trends inherent in heterogeneous clinical data modalities. This study evaluates an adaptive attention-based deep learning architecture that integrates Graph Attention Networks (GAT) with Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM) networks, augmented by a temporal attention mechanism, to optimize predictive performance without early feature fusion. The framework is evaluated across two distinct clinical objectives: binary cardiovascular risk prediction using the cross-sectional Framingham Heart Study dataset, and multi-class diagnostic superclass classification using the high-resolution PTB-XL ECG dataset, with a derived binary NORM vs. Non-NORM screening view for clinical triage evaluation. Class imbalance within the Framingham training folds is addressed using the Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique (SMOTE), applied strictly within each training fold to preventdata leakage. On the Framingham dataset, 5-fold stratified cross-validation yields an accuracy of 88.73 ± 1.54%, an AUC-ROC of 94.57 ± 0.67%, and an F1-score of 0.90. On the held-out PTB-XL test split, the model achieves a NORM-screening accuracy of 96.20%, a precision of 0.85, a recall of 0.98, and an F1-score of 0.91 with an overall 5-class classification accuracy of 96%. These outcomes outperform competitive machine learning and deep learning baselines, verifying the framework’s adaptability and capability to process heterogeneous clinical modalities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种自适应注意力深度学习架构（GAT+Bi-LSTM+时间注意力机制），在心血管疾病预测任务中，跨两个数据集（Framingham和PTB-XL）均取得优异表现，优于多种基线模型。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种能够同时捕捉异构临床数据中结构特征依赖和长期时间趋势的深度学习框架，以优化心血管疾病的早期检测性能？
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习方法难以联合捕捉异构临床数据模态中的结构性特征依赖关系和长期时间趋势，导致心血管疾病早期预测效果受限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 图注意力网络（GAT）捕捉特征间结构依赖；双向长短期记忆网络（Bi-LSTM）建模长期时间序列；时间注意力机制增强关键时间点权重；SMOTE处理类别不平衡。
AI.method: 自适应注意力深度学习架构：GAT + Bi-LSTM + 时间注意力机制；在Framingham数据集进行二分类心血管风险预测（5折分层交叉验证，SMOTE仅在训练折内应用防数据泄露）；在PTB-XL数据集进行5类诊断分类及NORM vs Non-NORM二分类筛查。
AI.findings: Framingham：准确率88.73%±1.54%，AUC-ROC 94.57%±0.67%，F1 0.90；PTB-XL：NORM筛查准确率96.20%，F1 0.91，5类分类准确率96%。均优于竞争性机器学习和深度学习基线。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出GAT+Bi-LSTM+时间注意力的融合架构，同时捕捉结构依赖与时间趋势；2. 验证了该架构在两种异构临床模态（横截面+高分辨率ECG）上的跨任务适应性；3. 展示了无需早期特征融合即可有效处理异构临床数据的设计思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为心血管疾病早期筛查提供高性能预测工具；2. 模型在NORM筛查任务中召回率达0.98，适合临床三级分诊场景，减少漏诊风险；3. 框架可适应不同数据模态，具有推广到其他疾病预测任务的潜力。

title: Rethinking Efficiency: A Structural Compression Framework for Domain-Specific Visual Recognition
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Rethinking Efficiency: A Structural Compression Framework for Domain-Specific Visual Recognition
detail.abstract: Pre-trained convolutional neural networks achieve strong performance through scaling strategies optimized for large benchmark datasets. However, when transferred to domain-specific visual recognition tasks, these models may allocate more depth and representational capacity than the target data require, leading to unnecessary computational overhead and an increased risk of overfitting. This paper proposes a structural compression framework for EfficientNet-B0 centered on stage-wise depth pruning as a capacity realignment mechanism for domain-specific datasets. By removing redundant MBConv repetitions, the proposed depthpruning strategy reduces parameters and FLOPs by 57% and 54%, respectively, while acting as an implicit architectural regularizer. Weight-preserving Ghost Convolutions and Efficient Channel Attention are then introduced as secondary refinements to further reduce redundant feature-generation and attention overhead. Unlike post-training compression or isolated block-level substitutions, the proposed framework first recalibrates the global depth of the backbone and then applies lightweight local refinements. Depthscaling and stage-wise integration ablations further separate the effect of global capacity reduction from the additional contribution of local lightweight components. Experiments on seven industrial and medical image datasets show that the resulting models achieve state-of-the-art or near state-of-the-art accuracy while reducing parameters by up to 77% and FLOPs by more than 60% compared with EfficientNet-B0.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种针对EfficientNet-B0的结构压缩框架，通过阶段级深度剪枝降低模型容量，再辅以Ghost卷积和高效通道注意力进行轻量化精修，在7个工业/医学数据集上实现参数减少77%、FLOPs减少60%以上，同时保持或接近最先进精度。
AI.research_question: 如何针对领域特定的小规模视觉识别任务，设计一种结构压缩框架来减少预训练卷积神经网络的不必要计算开销和过拟合风险？
AI.motivation: 预训练CNN通过大规模基准数据集的缩放策略获得强性能，但迁移到领域特定任务时，模型深度和表征能力可能远超目标数据需求，造成计算浪费和过拟合风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 阶段级深度剪枝作为能力重新对齐机制；隐式结构正则化；全局深度校准后局部轻量化精修的两阶段压缩策略。
AI.method: (1) 阶段级深度剪枝：去除冗余MBConv重复单元；(2) 加权保留Ghost卷积：减少冗余特征生成；(3) 高效通道注意力：减少注意力计算开销；(4) 深度缩放与阶段消融实验分离全局与局部贡献。
AI.findings: 参数减少57%和FLOPs减少54%（仅深度剪枝阶段）；最终模型参数减少高达77%，FLOPs减少超60%；在7个工业/医学图像数据集上达到SOTA或接近SOTA精度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出深度剪枝作为隐式结构正则化机制；建立"全局深度校准→局部轻量化精修"的两阶段压缩范式；通过消融实验分离全局容量缩减与局部轻量组件的各自贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为领域特定视觉任务提供高效模型压缩方案；显著降低参数量和计算量，便于边缘设备部署；在工业与医学图像等实际场景中验证了方法的有效性。

title: Pre-Recession Stress Patterns Extend the Early Warning Horizon: An Explainable Deep Learning Approach
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Universidade de Coimbra and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Pre-Recession Stress Patterns Extend the Early Warning Horizon: An Explainable Deep Learning Approach
detail.abstract: This study presents an explainable deep learning framework for characterizing pre-recession stress patterns up to 24 months in advance, contributing to monitoring assistance that supports proactive policy interventions by financial institutions. Traditional methods focus on recession events, neglecting the emergent buildup patterns that precede downturns.Given that the economy is a complex system, small variations in initial conditions may result in exponentially different trajectories, rendering the forecast of future states uncertain. We address this through an explainable deep learning framework that identifies these precursor signals. The approach combines traditional macroeconomic indicators with nonlinear dynamical features, including recurrence rates, Lyapunov exponents, and correlation dimension, applied to U.S. macroeconomic data (1961–2023). The proposed model achieves an F1-score of 85.4%, substantially outperforming benchmark static models (73.4%). Unemployment recurrence rates provide early COVID-19 recession signals when conventional indicators remain neutral. Concurrently, attention mechanisms dynamically shift temporal focus as regime transition approaches. These findings suggest that recessions could be better understood not as external shocks but as endogenous breakdowns of adaptive capacity. This framework contributes to extending the early-warning horizon by enabling policymakers to monitor instability precursors, facilitating interventions that can dampen or even prevent systemic breakdowns.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个可解释的深度学习框架，利用非线性动力学特征（递归率、李雅普诺夫指数、关联维数）结合传统宏观经济指标，在衰退发生前24个月识别预警信号，F1分数达85.4%，优于传统静态模型（73.4%）。研究发现失业率递归率可在传统指标中性时提前发出衰退信号，表明衰退应被理解为内生的适应能力崩溃而非外部冲击。
AI.research_question: 如何利用可解释的深度学习框架，在衰退发生前更早地识别和表征经济衰退的前兆（压力模式），从而扩展早期预警的时间窗口？
AI.motivation: 传统方法聚焦于衰退事件本身，忽视了衰退前逐渐累积的构建模式；经济作为复杂系统，初始条件的微小变化可能导致指数级不同的轨迹，使得预测未来状态具有不确定性。因此需要识别这些前兆信号来实现主动的政策干预。
AI.theoretical_framework: 复杂系统理论（经济作为复杂系统、初始条件敏感性）、非线性动力学（递归率、李雅普诺夫指数、关联维数）、深度学习与注意力机制、内生适应性崩溃理论。
AI.method: 可解释深度学习框架，结合传统宏观经济指标与非线性动力学特征（递归率、李雅普诺夫指数、关联维数），应用于美国宏观经济数据（1961-2023年），使用注意力机制动态调整时间聚焦。
AI.findings: 1) 模型F1分数达85.4%，显著优于基准静态模型（73.4%）；2) 失业率递归率可在传统指标保持中性时提前发出COVID-19衰退信号；3) 注意力机制在体制转变临近时动态转移时间焦点。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出衰退应被理解为内生的适应能力崩溃而非外部冲击，拓展了早期预警的理论视角；将非线性动力学特征纳入经济衰退预测的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构和政策制定者提供可解释的早期预警工具，将预警时间窗口提前至24个月，支持主动的政策干预，有助于抑制甚至防止系统性崩溃。

title: Emergence of Vascular Network Topology from Notch–Delta–Jagged Signaling and VEGF-Guided Migration
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Emergence of Vascular Network Topology from Notch–Delta–Jagged Signaling and VEGF-Guided Migration
detail.abstract: Tumor angiogenesis plays a fundamental role in cancer progression by promoting the formation of new blood vessels that supply oxygen and nutrients to neoplastic tissues. Understanding the mechanisms which drives this process is essential for the development of therapeutic strategies aimed at modulating tumor vascularization. In this study, an agent-based spatial adaptation of a mathematical model of cellular signaling involving Notch, Delta, Jagged, and vascular endothelial growth factor was developed to simulate the formation of two-dimensional vascular networks. Two distinct cell migration strategies were implemented, namely random migration and angiogenic gradient-guided migration, in order to investigate the impact of chemotaxis on the structural organization of the resulting networks. Simulations were performed on a 140 × 140 lattice, and the generated vascular structures were processed using skeletonization and graph-based analysis techniques, enabling the extraction of topological metrics related to vascular connectivity and geometry. The results showed that both models were able to reproducing the progressive formation of complex vascular structures, whereas the incorporation of angiogenic gradient-guided migration produced more spatially organized networks and faster structural stabilization. Comparison with experimental data revealed qualitative agreement in the temporal evolution of average degree and mean branch length, indicating that the model captures relevant aspects of angiogenic dynamics. These findings highlight the potential of integrating agent-based modeling, digital image processing, and complex network theory as a quantitative framework for investigating tumor angiogenesis and its emergent structural properties.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个基于主体的空间模型，模拟肿瘤血管生成中Notch、Delta、Jagged和VEGF信号通路驱动二维血管网络形成的过程，并对比了随机迁移与血管生成梯度引导迁移两种策略对血管网络结构的影响。
AI.research_question: 趋化性（血管生成梯度引导迁移）如何影响肿瘤血管网络的结构组织和拓扑特性？
AI.motivation: 肿瘤血管生成在癌症进展中起关键作用，理解其机制对开发调节肿瘤血管化的治疗策略至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于主体的建模、细胞信号传导（Notch、Delta、Jagged、VEGF）、复杂网络理论、数字图像处理
AI.method: 在140×140格点上进行基于主体的空间模拟，采用骨架化和图分析技术提取血管网络的拓扑度量，对比随机迁移与梯度引导迁移两种策略。
AI.findings: 两种模型均能再现复杂血管结构的逐步形成，但梯度引导迁移产生更有序的空间网络和更快的结构稳定；与实验数据在平均度和平均分支长度的时间演化上定性一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 将基于主体建模、数字图像处理和复杂网络理论整合为一个定量分析框架，用于研究肿瘤血管生成及其涌现结构特性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为开发调节肿瘤血管化的治疗策略提供建模工具和理论依据，有助于理解趋化性在血管网络结构组织中的作用。

title: Projective Shape Analysis of Spatial Orientation
affiliations: National University of Science and Technology POLITEHNICA Bucharest, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Florida State University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Projective Shape Analysis of Spatial Orientation
detail.abstract: In this article, we apply extrinsic data analysis to the study of cognitive abilities evaluated based on the learning behavior in the Dresden Spatial Navigation Task (DSNT) virtual navigational experiment. Projective Shape Analysis for Spatial Orientation (PSASO) is our novel mathematical modelling of spatial orientation and spatial learning that transforms the $2D$ trajectory analysis into a $3D$ moving landmark problem. It is based on recent concepts in object-oriented data analysis like extrinsic mean and extrinsic covariance as well as novel statistical testing methods for random objects on manifolds. The allocentric orientation patterns in persons exhibiting mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and controls are detected for the first time. Our research examines how trajectory patterns in the DSNT reveal the interplay between spatial learning and spatial long-term memory, as well as the landmark-based orientation. The one sample test for the extrinsic mean suggests a classification of the landmarks in three classes: ''remembered'' landmarks, ''forgettable'' landmarks and ''unlearnable'' landmarks. The orientation pattern of the MCI group displays mostly ''unlearnable'' or ''forgettable'' landmarks. Finally, the prediction of the MCI condition by Ada boosting proves an accuracy of 95% and offers hope for a new diagnostics tool for neurodegenerative diseases.

AI.tldr: 本文运用外蕴数据分析方法，基于德累斯顿空间导航任务（DSNT）虚拟导航实验中的学习行为评估认知能力。创新提出“空间定向投影形状分析”（PSASO）数学模型，将二维轨迹分析转化为三维移动地标问题。研究发现轻度认知障碍（MCI）组与对照组在异我中心定向模式上存在差异，并通过AdaBoost实现95%的MCI预测准确率。
AI.research_question: 如何利用DSNT虚拟导航实验中的轨迹数据，通过外蕴数据分析方法识别轻度认知障碍（MCI）患者的空间定向与空间学习模式？
AI.motivation: 探索基于虚拟导航行为的新诊断工具，为神经退行性疾病提供早期、非侵入性的检测方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 外蕴数据分析（Extrinsic Data Analysis）、面向对象数据分析、投影形状分析（PSASO）、流形上的随机对象统计检验。
AI.method: PSASO数学模型（将2D轨迹转为3D移动地标问题）；外蕴均值与外蕴协方差；单样本外蕴均值检验；AdaBoost分类器。
AI.findings: 1. 地标可分为三类：记住的、可遗忘的、不可学习的。2. MCI组主要表现为“不可学习”或“可遗忘”地标模式。3. AdaBoost预测MCI准确率达95%。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将外蕴数据分析与投影形状分析应用于空间导航轨迹建模，提出PSASO新方法，拓展了面向对象数据分析在认知科学中的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为MCI早期诊断提供了基于虚拟导航行为的高精度（95%）预测工具，有望应用于阿尔茨海默病等神经退行性疾病的筛查。

title: Feynman-Kac Methods in Option Pricing: A Review

detail.title: Feynman-Kac Methods in Option Pricing: A Review

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This review examines the Feynman-Kac formula and its use in optionpricing problems, using state description as the main organising idea for comparing different payoff structures. It first introduces Kac's original path-functional intuition and the modern backward and forward Feynman-Kac representations. Then, the Black-Scholes model is introduced as the basic Markovian case for applying the formula, before the review moves to path-dependent options, such as Asian options, barrier options and lookback options. Finally, the review extends the discussion to more general path-dependent options by introducing functional Itô calculus and path-dependent PDEs, in which the whole past path is treated as the state. Overall, the review shows how state description connects payoff structures, pricing PDEs and Feynman-Kac representations.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了Feynman-Kac公式在期权定价中的应用，以状态描述为核心组织思想，比较了不同 payoff 结构，从经典Black-Scholes模型扩展到路径依赖期权，并引入函数Itô演算和路径依赖PDE。
AI.research_question: Feynman-Kac公式如何用于期权定价，以及状态描述如何连接不同支付结构与定价方程？
AI.motivation: 路径依赖期权（如亚式、障碍、回溯期权）的定价比标准欧式期权更复杂，需要一个统一的理论框架来理解不同payoff结构下的定价机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: Feynman-Kac公式（正向与反向表示）、Black-Scholes模型、函数Itô演算、路径依赖PDE。
AI.method: 综述性研究，通过状态描述（马尔可夫状态 vs. 完整路径状态）作为主线，梳理不同期权类型的Feynman-Kac表示。
AI.findings: 状态描述是连接payoff结构、定价PDE和Feynman-Kac表示的关键。标准期权用当前价格作为状态，路径依赖期权需引入额外状态变量；更一般的路径依赖期权则需用函数Itô演算将整个路径作为状态。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地以"状态描述"统一了不同期权定价问题的Feynman-Kac公式应用，并展示了函数Itô演算如何将路径依赖问题纳入该框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融从业者提供了从标准期权到复杂路径依赖期权的定价理论图谱，帮助理解不同定价模型之间的内在联系。

title: Digital Markets and Farmer Welfare: How Electronic Integration Reshapes India's Agricultural Market Economy

detail.title: Digital Markets and Farmer Welfare: How Electronic Integration Reshapes India's Agricultural Market Economy
detail.abstract: Better market information is known to raise farm-gate prices and to integrate spatially separated markets, yet whether a state-sponsored digital marketplace delivers these gains, and through which margin, remains unsettled. This paper studies India's electronic National Agriculture Market (e-NAM), which has connected more than one thousand regulated wholesale markets since 2016, using the near-universe of official daily price records: 28.6 million market-commodity-day observations across fourteen commodities, 6,623 markets, and 33 states over 2001 to 2026. Exploiting the staggered timing of state-level integration in a difference-in-differences design estimated with modern heterogeneity-robust estimators, the study finds that e-NAM did not raise average real prices or measurably compress spatial price gaps, but it reduced the risk embedded in the prices farmers face. Within-month price volatility falls by about 0.0139, roughly seventeen percent of the sample mean coefficient of variation, and the monthly price range narrows, with both effects emerging gradually as platform use ramps up. Interpreted through a certainty-equivalent framework, the risk reduction is worth on the order of 0.08 to 0.35 percent of price income for risk-averse farmers. These findings indicate that the first-order welfare contribution of digital market integration in a developing agricultural economy may lie in price stabilization rather than in price levels.

AI.tldr: 本文研究印度电子国家农业市场（e-NAM）的效果，发现该平台并未提高农民的平均实际价格或缩小空间价格差距，但显著降低了农民面临的价格波动风险（月度价格波动率下降约17%），为风险规避型农民带来了相当于价格收入0.08-0.35%的确定性等价收益。研究表明，发展中国家数字市场整合的首要福利贡献可能在于价格稳定而非价格水平提升。
AI.research_question: 国家资助的数字市场平台（印度e-NAM）是否提高了农民的实际价格、整合了空间市场、以及降低了价格风险？其福利贡献主要通过哪个渠道实现？
AI.motivation: 已有理论认为更好的市场信息能提高农场价格并整合空间分离的市场，但国家资助的数字市场能否实现这些收益、通过何种边际渠道实现，尚未得到充分实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场信息理论、确定性等价框架（certainty-equivalent framework）
AI.method: 利用2001-2026年印度2860万条市场-商品-日度观测数据，采用交错双重差分设计（staggered difference-in-differences），并使用现代异质性稳健估计量（heterogeneity-robust estimators）进行估计。
AI.findings: e-NAM未提高平均实际价格，也未显著缩小空间价格差距；但降低了月度价格波动率（约0.0139，约为样本均值变异系数的17%），缩小了月度价格区间；该效果随平台使用增加而逐渐显现；对风险规避型农民而言，风险降低的确定性等价价值约为价格收入的0.08-0.35%。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了数字市场整合在发展中国家农业经济中的首要福利贡献机制并非价格水平提升，而是价格稳定，为市场信息理论提供了新的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 对发展中国家农业数字平台政策设计具有重要启示：应更关注价格稳定效应而非单纯追求价格提升，并认识到平台效果需要时间积累才能充分显现。

title: Research Note 26-1 The Proposed Section 301 Tariffs for Forced Labor are Vastly Excessive
affiliations: Peterson Institute for International Economics

detail.title: Research Note 26-1 The Proposed Section 301 Tariffs for Forced Labor are Vastly Excessive
detail.abstract: Proposed tariffs of 10 to 12.5 percent under the forced labor provisions of Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974 would be more than forty times the magnitude that could be warranted on the basis of US exports lost and US imports increased as a consequence of trade in goods produced using forced labor. The basic reason is that in economic terms, global forced labor is small, accounting for an estimated 5.5 million workers in tradable goods, compared to almost 2 billion workers in these sectors globally. As a consequence, the forced-labor provisions do not constitute a credible basis for replacing the reciprocal tariffs ruled illegal by the Supreme Court.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，美国依据《1974年贸易法》第301条强迫劳动条款拟征收的10%至12.5%关税，其幅度远超因强迫劳动商品贸易实际导致的美国出口损失和进口增加所能合理支持的水平（高出40倍以上），原因在于全球强迫劳动在经济规模上非常小（可贸易商品领域仅约550万工人，而全球该领域有近20亿工人）。因此，强迫劳动条款不能成为替代被最高法院裁定为非法的互惠关税的可靠依据。
AI.research_question: 美国拟依据强迫劳动条款征收的10%-12.5%关税，其经济合理性如何？该条款能否作为被最高法院裁定为非法的互惠关税的替代依据？
AI.motivation: 分析强迫劳动条款关税与实际贸易影响之间的巨大差距，揭示其不能作为替代互惠关税的合理政策工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际贸易经济学、强迫劳动的经济规模分析、关税政策合理性评估。
AI.method: 定量分析：比较拟议关税幅度与基于强迫劳动商品贸易实际影响的合理关税水平，利用全球强迫劳动规模数据（550万 vs 20亿工人）进行估算。
AI.findings: 拟议关税（10%-12.5%）远超合理水平（高出40倍以上），因为全球强迫劳动在可贸易商品领域的经济规模极小（仅占全球从业人员的约2.75%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了国际贸易政策中强迫劳动条款的经济局限性，为评估贸易制裁的合理性提供了量化分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于强迫劳动条款关税不合理性的证据，指出其不能作为替代被最高法院否决的互惠关税的合法工具。

title: Moving Targets: Regulatory Uncertainty and Agri-Food Trade. A Structural Gravity Model of EU Pesticide Maximum Residue Limits

detail.title: Moving Targets: Regulatory Uncertainty and Agri-Food Trade. A Structural Gravity Model of EU Pesticide Maximum Residue Limits
detail.abstract: A large literature establishes that the level and crosscountry heterogeneity of food-safety standards reduce agri-food trade. A third channel, the uncertainty generated by how frequently and unpredictably those standards are revised, has received little attention, largely because it is difficult to measure and identify. This paper develops a structural gravity model of this channel and applies it to European Union pesticide maximum residue limits. Three elements make up the approach: a product-by-year index of MRL-revision uncertainty, built by principal-component analysis from the amendment record of Regulation (EC) No 396/2005; a theory-consistent gravity equation motivated by a real-options argument, in which the sunk cost of market entry makes waiting more valuable as regulatory volatility rises; and a control-function instrumental-variables strategy based on the statutory active-substance renewal calendar. The model is estimated on a panel of 36 exporters, the 27 EU member states as importers, 25 agri-food product groups, and the years 2004 to 2020, built on the CEPII gravity database. A one-standard-deviation increase in uncertainty is associated with about a 17.5% reduction in bilateral trade. The estimate is stable when the level and heterogeneity of the same standards are controlled for and across a range of robustness checks, and the response is concentrated on the extensive margin, the entry of product lines, rather than the intensive margin, as the real-options mechanism predicts. The effect is larger for developing exporters and for perishable, testing-intensive products. The results indicate that the predictability of food-safety regulation, and not only its stringency, shapes market access.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了食品安全标准修订的不确定性对农产品贸易的影响，发现标准修订频率和不可预测性显著减少了双边贸易，且这一效应主要通过影响产品进入（集约边际）而非现有贸易量（广延边际）发挥作用，对发展中国家和易腐产品影响更大。
AI.research_question: 食品安全标准修订的不确定性如何影响农产品贸易？
AI.motivation: 已有文献主要关注食品安全标准的水平和跨国异质性对贸易的抑制作用，但标准修订的频率和不可预测性（即不确定性）这一渠道几乎未被研究，主要原因是难以测量和识别其因果效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于实物期权理论（real-options argument）的结构性引力模型：市场进入的沉没成本使得监管波动性上升时，等待的价值增加，从而抑制贸易。
AI.method: 1）通过主成分分析法构建产品-年份层面的最大残留限量修订不确定性指数；2）推导理论一致的引力方程；3）基于法定活性物质更新日历的工具变量策略进行控制函数估计。
AI.findings: 不确定性每增加一个标准差，双边贸易减少约17.5%；效应主要集中在广延边际（产品线进入）而非集约边际；对发展中国家出口商和易腐、检测密集型产品影响更大；在控制标准水平和异质性后结果稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统阐明并实证检验了食品安全标准修订不确定性作为贸易壁垒的独立机制，拓展了传统贸易标准研究视角，为实物期权理论在贸易政策领域的应用提供了新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示政策制定者：食品安全监管的可预测性（而非仅严格程度）对市场准入至关重要，尤其影响发展中国家和易腐产品贸易；标准修订的透明度和稳定性应成为贸易便利化的重要考量。

title: Stablecoins and Banks
affiliations: Deutsche Bundesbank - Research Centre

detail.title: Stablecoins and Banks
detail.abstract: When distress hits, which way does private digital money run, and what happens to bank funding? We classify every major dollar token by two exposures, its bank dependence and its crypto dependence, and build a calibrated model of a market in which bank deposits, crypto collateral, and Treasuries all carry risk. After SVB the largest bank-dependent issuer cut the bank-deposit share of its reserve from 24.9 to about 5 percent and stayed below 15 percent through 2025; crypto-origin crises move holders the opposite way. The model prices the GENIUS reserve menu on a frontier regulation cannot remove.

AI.tldr: 本文研究私人数字美元（稳定币）在银行危机（如SVB）和加密危机期间如何调整其储备资产配置，以及这对银行融资的影响。作者构建了一个包含银行存款、加密抵押品和美国国债三种风险资产的模型，发现银行依赖型稳定币在银行危机后会大幅减少银行存款占比，而加密起源的危机则导致相反方向的资金流动。模型揭示了监管无法消除的储备资产选择边界。
AI.research_question: 当银行危机或加密危机发生时，私人数字美元（稳定币）如何调整其储备资产配置？这对银行融资有何影响？
AI.motivation: 理解稳定币在危机时期的资金流向行为及其对传统银行体系的影响，探讨监管能否消除其中的风险权衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 构建了一个包含三种风险资产（银行存款、加密抵押品、美国国债）的市场均衡模型，其中稳定币发行者面临资产配置选择。
AI.method: 实证分析（SVB事件前后最大银行依赖型稳定币的储备数据）结合理论模型校准。
AI.findings: 1) SVB事件后，最大银行依赖型稳定币将其银行存款占比从24.9%降至约5%，并长期维持低于15%；2) 加密危机则导致持有者向相反方向（增加银行存款）转移；3) 模型显示存在监管无法消除的储备资产选择前沿（GENIUS储备菜单）。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了稳定币储备资产配置中存在监管无法消除的内在权衡边界，为理解数字美元与银行体系的交互提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构理解稳定币风险传导机制提供依据，提示仅靠监管无法完全消除稳定币的储备资产风险选择问题。

title: Can Reinforcement Learning Efficiently Discover Price Manipulation?
affiliations: Scuola Normale Superiore, Scuola Normale Superiore and Scuola Normale Superiore

detail.title: Can Reinforcement Learning Efficiently Discover Price Manipulation?
detail.abstract: In this paper, we investigate whether a model-free RL agent can identify and exploit price manipulation opportunities more effectively than a traditional modelbased approach that assumes correct specification of the data-generating process but relies on noisy parameter estimates. We consider a single-asset market in which prices evolve according to an Almgren-Chriss framework with non-linear permanent impact and linear temporary impact. We first establish the existence of price-manipulative strategies in discrete time and compute the optimal benchmark strategy using Sequential Least Squares Quadratic Programming under full information. We then compare two finite-sample learning approaches: a modelbased procedure that estimates impact parameters from simulated execution data and an agnostic RL approach based on Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient, trained directly on the same amount of data. For intermediate volatility, the RL agent successfully discovers profitable manipulative strategies without explicit knowledge of the underlying model, even when training data are quite limited. More importantly, RL consistently outperforms the model-based approach when parameter estimates are affected by sampling error, despite the latter benefiting from the correct model specification. For large volatility, all methods are unable to identify manipulation opportunities, while for small volatility, the model based approach outperforms RL. These findings highlight both the effectiveness of RL in complex control problems and the risks associated with deploying learning algorithms in financial markets without appropriate safeguards.

AI.tldr: 本文研究无模型强化学习（RL）代理能否比传统基于模型的方法更有效地发现和利用价格操纵机会。在Almgren-Chriss市场影响框架下，RL代理在中等波动率下无需模型知识即可发现盈利操纵策略，且在参数估计存在噪声时持续优于正确设定但参数估计有误的模型方法。
AI.research_question: 无模型强化学习代理能否比传统基于模型的方法（假设数据生成过程正确设定但依赖有噪声的参数估计）更有效地识别和利用价格操纵机会？
AI.motivation: 传统基于模型的方法虽然正确设定了数据生成过程，但参数估计存在噪声；而RL作为无模型方法，可能在实际有限样本条件下更具优势。研究旨在比较两者在价格操纵策略发现上的表现差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: Almgren-Chriss市场影响模型（非线性永久影响+线性临时影响）；离散时间价格操纵策略存在性证明；Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG) 强化学习算法
AI.method: 先证明离散时间下价格操纵策略的存在性，并用SLSQP计算全信息下的最优基准策略；然后比较两种有限样本学习方法：基于模型的方法（估计冲击参数）与无模型RL方法（DDPG），在相同数据量下进行训练和测试。
AI.findings: 中等波动率下，RL代理无需模型知识即可发现盈利操纵策略，即使训练数据相当有限；RL在参数估计受采样误差影响时持续优于正确指定模型的方法；大波动率下所有方法均无法识别操纵机会；小波动率下基于模型的方法优于RL。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了离散时间下Almgren-Chriss框架中价格操纵策略的存在性；揭示了无模型RL在复杂金融控制问题中的有效性边界（波动率依赖性）。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示了RL在金融市场部署中的风险（无适当保障措施时可能发现并利用操纵策略）；为监管和交易系统设计提供了不同学习方法在操纵识别能力上的对比依据。

title: Digital Markets and Farmer Welfare: How Electronic Integration Reshapes India's Agricultural Market Economy

detail.title: Digital Markets and Farmer Welfare: How Electronic Integration Reshapes India's Agricultural Market Economy
detail.abstract: Better market information is known to raise farm-gate prices and to integrate spatially separated markets, yet whether a state-sponsored digital marketplace delivers these gains, and through which margin, remains unsettled. This paper studies India's electronic National Agriculture Market (e-NAM), which has connected more than one thousand regulated wholesale markets since 2016, using the near-universe of official daily price records: 28.6 million market-commodity-day observations across fourteen commodities, 6,623 markets, and 33 states over 2001 to 2026. Exploiting the staggered timing of state-level integration in a difference-in-differences design estimated with modern heterogeneity-robust estimators, the study finds that e-NAM did not raise average real prices or measurably compress spatial price gaps, but it reduced the risk embedded in the prices farmers face. Within-month price volatility falls by about 0.0139, roughly seventeen percent of the sample mean coefficient of variation, and the monthly price range narrows, with both effects emerging gradually as platform use ramps up. Interpreted through a certainty-equivalent framework, the risk reduction is worth on the order of 0.08 to 0.35 percent of price income for risk-averse farmers. These findings indicate that the first-order welfare contribution of digital market integration in a developing agricultural economy may lie in price stabilization rather than in price levels.

AI.tldr: 本文研究印度电子国家农业市场（e-NAM）的影响，发现该数字平台并未提高平均价格或缩小空间价格差异，但显著降低了农民面临的价格波动风险，月度价格波动率下降约17%，表明数字市场整合的首要福利贡献在于价格稳定而非价格水平提升。
AI.research_question: 国家资助的数字市场平台能否提升农产品价格并整合空间市场？其福利效应通过何种渠道实现？
AI.motivation: 已有理论认为更好的市场信息能提高农场价格并整合市场，但关于国家资助的数字平台能否实现这些收益、通过何种边际渠道发挥作用，尚无定论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 确定性等价框架（certainty-equivalent framework），用于量化价格风险降低对风险厌恶型农民的福利价值。
AI.method: 利用各邦分期整合的错峰时间，采用双重差分法（difference-in-differences），并结合现代异质性稳健估计量，分析2001-2026年间2860万条市场-商品-日度观测数据。
AI.findings: e-NAM并未提高平均实际价格或显著压缩空间价差，但降低了农民面临的价格风险：月内价格波动率下降约0.0139（约为样本均值变异系数的17%），月度价格区间收窄，且效应随平台使用率提升而逐渐显现。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示数字市场整合在发展中农业经济中的首要福利贡献在于价格稳定而非价格水平，为信息中介理论提供了新的实证维度和机制解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家农业数字平台的政策评估提供重要参考，提示政策制定者应关注价格稳定效应而非仅追求价格提升，风险降低对农民的福利价值约为价格的0.08%至0.35%。

title: An Asset-Backing Model (ABM²) of the Risk-Free Rate: Endogenizing the Discount Rate in a Backing Economy
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: An Asset-Backing Model (ABM²) of the Risk-Free Rate: Endogenizing the Discount Rate in a Backing Economy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is employed by the State Treasury of Finland (Valtiokonttori) as a public official. This paper was produced in a personal capacity; the views expressed are the author's own and do not represent the State Treasury of Finland. The author declares no competing financial or personal interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Paper 1 pins the price level of a no-government economy as the fixed point VoM = [G·v + Λ(VoM)]/D but takes the discount rate r and the anchor's real value v as given. This paper endogenizes both from one representative household, using the same anchor. Not the rate levels — these are standard (Ramsey/Fisher r* = ρ, a Lucas-tree anchor price, a Krishnamurthy–Vissing-Jorgensen wedge r_safe = ρ − κ_m(1+ρ)) — but three joins only the shared anchor makes visible. (1) The anchor price is independent of the nominal level (v ⊥ P), converting Paper 1's assumption (R1) into a derived property and closing the monetary half of its circularity; the real half stays assumed. (2) The bank's charter value is the capitalized convenience rent, V_f = κ_m·B·(1−PD)/(r+PD) (B the deposit book's debt value, PD the bank's default probability): because temptation κ_m·B and franchise-at-risk κ_m·V_f cancel, optimal leverage is κ_m-independent. The bank rate then aligns with the natural rate, provided the bank keeps the rent; contestability competes it away. (3) Paper 1's determinacy modulus is the bank's loan-pricing credit delta scaled by leverage (δ = ℓ·∂B/∂K, Theorem 2.16). So monetary determinacy and bank capital structure are one primitive, and Keeley competition-fragility becomes a determinacy statement. Beneath all three is a rate ⊥ level dichotomy mirroring Paper 1's determinacy ⊥ stability; one departure — a partly-monetary anchor — breaks both. Scope: steady state plus a reduced-form dynamic, representative agent, log utility, no term structure, no empirics. A closing live-measured section (§6, Result 2.18 — measured on the author's private simulation engine) supplies the calibrated rate levels the analytic core does not carry — the produced natural rate 0.03505 and net interest margin (NIM) 0.01515, against the administered deposit wedge 0.02000 and deposit rate 0.01000. Nothing is fitted to data. The anchor that values money also disciplines the rate.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一个共同锚点（Lucas树）将家庭部门内生化到无政府经济的价格水平固定点模型中，揭示了三个仅由共享锚点可见的联结：（1）锚点价格独立于名义水平；（2）银行特许权价值与最优杠杆对κ_m不敏感；（3）货币决定性与银行资本结构实为同一问题。稳态下提供了校准利率水平，并论证了货币锚定同样约束利率。
AI.research_question: 如何通过一个共同锚点（Lucas树）将家庭部门内生化，从而将货币价格水平决定与利率决定统一在一个框架中，并揭示银行资本结构、货币决定性与竞争-脆弱性之间的内在联系？
AI.motivation: 先前的研究（Paper 1）将贴现率r和锚点实际价值v视为外生给定，但未解释其来源。本文通过代表性家庭效用最大化内生决定r和v，从而解决Paper 1中的循环论证问题，并揭示货币理论与银行理论之间的深层联系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Lucas树锚点模型、Ramsey/Fisher最优消费模型（r* = ρ）、Krishnamurthy–Vissing-Jorgensen安全资产溢价楔子（r_safe = ρ − κ_m(1+ρ)），以及Keeley竞争-脆弱性理论。核心思想是共同锚点同时约束货币价格水平和利率。
AI.method: 代表性代理人、对数效用、稳态分析加简化形式动态、无期限结构、无实证检验。使用私人模拟引擎进行校准（Result 2.18）。
AI.findings: (1) 锚点价格独立于名义价格水平，将Paper 1的假设转化为导出性质；(2) 银行特许权价值为资本化便利租金V_f = κ_m·B·(1−PD)/(r+PD)，最优杠杆与κ_m无关；(3) 货币决定性模量等于银行信贷乘数（δ = ℓ·∂B/∂K），Keeley竞争-脆弱性转化为决定性问题；(4) 校准结果：自然利率0.03505，净息差0.01515，存款楔子0.02000，存款利率0.01000。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 将货币价格水平决定与利率决定统一在同一锚点框架下；(2) 揭示了货币决定性与银行资本结构的一体性，即同一个“原始量”；(3) 将Keeley竞争-脆弱性重新表述为货币决定性问题；(4) 发现了利率与价格水平之间的正交二分法（level ⊥ rate），这一二分法的破坏会导致两个维度的不稳定。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为央行和监管机构提供了理解货币稳定与银行资本结构统一性的理论工具；(2) 校准结果提供了自然利率和净息差的参考数值；(3) 揭示了银行竞争（contestability）如何影响便利租金和利率水平。

title: The Gradualism Gap: Under-Provided Adaptation to Slow-Onset Climate Risk
affiliations: National University of Singapore (NUS), Department of Economics

detail.title: The Gradualism Gap: Under-Provided Adaptation to Slow-Onset Climate Risk

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I have no conflict of interest to declare.
declarations.funderStatement: I have no funder info to declare.

detail.abstract: Most climate change is slow-onset, yet standard damage functions assume frictionless adaptation. Holding cumulative loss fixed, gradual erosion induces less private adaptation than a sudden loss, because slow damage never becomes salient enough to trigger costly adjustment. I call this the gradualism gap. Coastal erosion is the laboratory, where the same shoreline loss arrives through chronic retreat or a single storm, measured identically. On a national panel of the eroding US coast, gradually eroding tracts undertake far fewer federal buyouts, elevate fewer buildings, and price coastal risk less into house values, a threshold response rising only at the most sudden tracts. A flood-map update that makes standing risk official reallocates adaptation toward them, identifying inattention rather than cost as the friction. The gap reappears for high-tide flooding, so it reflects perception rather than coasts. Making gradual risk as visible as a storm recovers a meaningful part of the foregone adaptation.

AI.tldr: 论文指出，尽管大部分气候变化是缓慢发生的，但标准损害函数假设了无摩擦的适应。研究发现，相对于突然的损失，渐进性的侵蚀会导致更少的私人适应，因为缓慢的损害不足以触发昂贵的调整——这一现象被称为“渐进主义缺口”。基于美国海岸线数据，论文证实渐进侵蚀地区的买断、建筑抬高和房价风险定价都显著更低，而洪水地图更新和可视化干预可以部分弥补这一缺口。
AI.research_question: 为什么相对于突然的损失，渐进性气候损害会导致私人适应不足？这种“渐进主义缺口”的机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 大部分气候变化是缓慢发生的，但标准经济模型通常假设适应是无摩擦的。这一假设可能严重高估了实际适应水平，因为缓慢的损害可能无法引起足够的注意和行动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 注意力经济理论、行为经济学中的突显性(salience)理论、以及适应的摩擦成本理论。
AI.method: 利用美国海岸线面板数据，比较渐进侵蚀（慢性海岸退缩）与突发损失（单次风暴）的适应行为差异，采用阈值回归等方法分析联邦买断计划、建筑抬高和房价数据。
AI.findings: 渐进侵蚀地区的联邦买断、建筑抬高数量和海啸风险定价均显著低于突发损失地区；适应性仅在风险最突然的地区才显著上升；洪水地图更新使官方风险信息可及后，适应重新向渐进侵蚀地区分配；这一缺口在高潮洪水中也存在，表明是普遍性的感知问题而非海岸特有。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并实证检验了“渐进主义缺口”(gradualism gap)概念，将注意力与突显性引入气候适应的经济学分析，挑战了标准损害函数的无摩擦适应假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为气候政策制定者提供了重要启示：需要通过政策干预（如洪水地图更新、风险可视化）来弥补渐进性风险的适应不足，使缓慢发生的风险“像风暴一样可见”。

title: When Funding Markets Move Credit Markets: Foreign Investors and U.S. CLOs
affiliations: The Wharton School and University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) - Anderson School of Management

detail.title: When Funding Markets Move Credit Markets: Foreign Investors and U.S. CLOs
detail.abstract: We show that U.S. leveraged credit markets and global dollar funding markets are jointly determined through the portfolio and funding decisions of Japanese banks, which hold roughly one-quarter of all U.S. CLO AAA tranches. The JPY–USD cross-currency basis, which measures the cost of obtaining dollars via FX swaps and forwards, is a strong predictor of AAA spreads and issuance, a relationship not found among other safe-assets. We develop a two-market equilibrium model in which the strength of pass-through from funding conditions to CLO spreads is governed by the aggregate demand elasticity of Japanese banks. We confirm the model's central prediction using three identification strategies: Japan's 2019 Basel III securitization rules, the Bank of Japan's 2023–2024 policy normalization, and quarter-end balance-sheet reporting cycles. Shocks that increase demand elasticity amplify basis pass-through, while shocks that decrease it dampen pass-through. These shocks are typically modeled as demand shifters. We show they also tilt the demand curve, altering the sensitivity of credit pricing to funding conditions. As a result, foreign market share alone understates domestic credit markets' vulnerability to external funding shocks, as spillovers depend not only on the level of participation but also on the elasticity of foreign investors' demand.

detail.abstract: Despite vaccines, pertussis remains a source of preventable infant morbidity and mortality, with periodic outbreaks worldwide. In response to evolving challenges, the Global Pertussis Initiative proposes a forward-looking, globally applicable vaccination framework to help countries adapt national strategies according to capacity and resources. Regardless of vaccines used, priorities are, in order: (1) optimal protection of newborns, infants and young children, via Tdap vaccination during each pregnancy, and high coverage, timely completion, and expansion of DTP3 to DTP4 (i.e., primary series and first booster in second year of life); (2) improved impact of existing delivery platforms and reduction of missed immunization opportunities; (3) school-entry booster; (4) adolescent booster; (5) adult risk-based boosters and opportunistic Tdap substitution (Td→Tdap). Countries should aim to implement Priority 1 and progress through subsequent priorities, as resources allow. This roadmap supports efficient resource allocation, broader life-course protection, stronger delivery systems, disease awareness, reduced hesitancy, and improved surveillance.

title: Converging Development-Mediated Exposures and the Emerging Young-Adult Cardiovascular Burden in Guyana: A Complex Adaptive Systems Framework

detail.title: Converging Development-Mediated Exposures and the Emerging Young-Adult Cardiovascular Burden in Guyana: A Complex Adaptive Systems Framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The analytical framework was developed on the basis of peer-reviewed evidence and the causal-chain methodology described in the paper, and was not calibrated to favour any specific project or commercial application.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently by the author without financial support from any commercial, governmental, or institutional source.

detail.abstract:
Guyana’s rapidly expanding oil economy has generated accelerated infrastructure development, urbanisation, and household income growth since commercial production commenced in 2019. Against this backdrop, a clinically documented emergence of cardiovascular disease (CVD) among younger adults has raised questions regarding whether conventional risk-factor models adequately capture the health consequences of rapid development transition. Existing analyses of Guyana’s CVD burden primarily model hypertension, diet, physical inactivity, and related contributors as independent variables. This paper argues that such additive approaches may be insufficient for explaining cardiovascular risk arising from multiple interacting development-mediated exposures and proposes a complex adaptive systems (CAS) framework as a complementary explanatory model.
The framework identifies four interacting exposure domains associated with rapid development: sedentary lifestyle transition, dietary chemical load intensification, agrochemical exposure expansion, and construction-related particulate matter exposure. Each domain possesses independent peer-reviewed evidence linking it to cardiovascular mechanisms, including systemic inflammation, oxidative stress, endothelial dysfunction, and hypertensive pathways. The paper conceptualises these domains as interconnected subsystems generated by a shared upstream driver: oil-boom-associated development. 
Drawing on complexity science principles of nonlinearity, feedback dynamics, and emergence, the framework proposes that interactions among these domains may produce cardiovascular risk patterns that differ from predictions based on isolated risk-factor analysis. This distinction has implications for intervention design, shifting emphasis from primarily downstream behavioural modification toward structural interventions addressing upstream conditions of exposure, including environmental regulation, food-system governance, construction emission controls, and health-oriented urban planning.
The paper presents a hypothesis-generating systems framework rather than an empirical causal estimate. Its contribution is the application of complexity science to cardiovascular transition analysis in a rapidly developing small state, providing a foundation for future longitudinal investigation of multi-domain exposure pathways and population health outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文针对圭亚那石油经济快速发展背景下年轻人心血管疾病（CVD）发病率上升的现象，提出传统风险因素叠加模型不足以解释发展转型中的健康后果，转而构建复杂适应系统（CAS）框架，识别四个交互暴露域（久坐生活方式、膳食化学负荷、农业化学暴露、建筑颗粒物暴露），强调非线性、反馈和涌现机制，为未来纵向研究提供理论基础。
AI.research_question: 在圭亚那石油经济快速发展的背景下，传统风险因素模型能否充分解释年轻人群中新兴的心血管疾病负担？复杂适应系统框架是否能提供更有效的补充性解释？
AI.motivation: 圭亚那自2019年石油商业生产以来，基础设施、城市化和家庭收入快速增长，但临床记录显示年轻人心血管疾病发病率上升，传统仅将高血压、饮食、缺乏运动等作为独立变量的分析模型可能遗漏发展带来的多因素交互效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 复杂适应系统（CAS）理论，核心概念包括非线性、反馈动力学和涌现机制，用以解释四个暴露域（久坐生活方式、膳食化学负荷、农业化学暴露、建筑颗粒物暴露）之间的交互作用如何产生不同于孤立风险因素预测的心血管风险模式。
AI.method: 理论建构与假设生成型框架设计，非实证因果估算。通过整合已有独立同行评议证据，将四个暴露域链接至系统性炎症、氧化应激、内皮功能障碍和高血压等心血管机制，并基于复杂性科学原理构建多域交互模型。
AI.findings: 传统加法模型可能低估发展相关多暴露交互产生的心血管风险；CAS框架揭示各暴露域由石油繁荣这一共同上游驱动因素产生，且彼此之间存在非线性交互和涌现效应；干预重点应从下游行为改变转向结构性干预，如环境规制、食品体系治理、建筑排放控制和健康导向城市规划。
AI.theory_contributions: 将复杂性科学引入心血管转型分析，应用于快速发展的弱小国家情境，为传统流行病学风险因素模型提供理论补充，提出多域暴露路径与人群健康结果的纵向研究基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供结构性干预方向，包括环境监管、食品体系治理、建筑排放控制及健康城市规划，而非仅局限于个人行为干预，有助于更有效地应对快速发展转型中的心血管疾病负担。

detail.abstract: We estimate the effect of groundwater shocks on maternal health and birth outcomes in India. Fetching water is largely a gendered task that falls on women who have to travel further during times of water scarcity. We estimate that lagged and contemporaneous negative shocks to groundwater levels increase medically terminated pregnancies, deliveries via cesarean section, and rates of anemia among mothers. We find no consistent evidence of an effect on stillbirths. Negative groundwater shocks increase distance traveled to water sources, but only weakly reduce food consumption and income, suggesting that maternal health is affected by groundwater scarcity through both physiological and economic channels.

title: Financial Vigilance: How Smartphone Finance Shapes Household Financial Well-Being
affiliations: University of Colorado at Denver - Department of Finance

detail.title: Financial Vigilance: How Smartphone Finance Shapes Household Financial Well-Being
detail.abstract: Digital finance is typically credited with making transactions faster and cheaper, but its deeper effect may be psychological: making financial information visible enough that households no longer need to hoard cash to feel in control of their money. We introduce financial vigilance, continuous monitoring and management of personal finances, as the behavioral channel linking smartphone finance to household outcomes. Using the 2025 Global Findex Microdata (2024 wave) and Lewbel instrumental variable estimation, we find smartphone finance significantly raises financial inclusion, resilience, and vigilance, exceeding effects of digital payments alone; vigilance itself predicts better inclusion and resilience.

title: AI-assisted Creation, Curation, and the Loss of Judgment

detail.title: AI-assisted Creation, Curation, and the Loss of Judgment
detail.abstract: I construct a model of content creation and curation with artificial intelligence (AI). Although AI-assisted works dilute the market for creators whose work trained the AI, the assignment of property rights can restore efficiency and incentives to create. By contrast, AI's capacity to displace human-generated judgment of content not only degrades its training data when it trains on AI-generated reviews, it also inverts the relative ranking of AI-assisted, novel, and derivative works relative to consumer preferences. Because information from human judgment is a byproduct of curation, it is unpriced and its erosion from the voluntary use of AI is difficult to address with taxes, data markets, or the assignment of property rights.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个AI内容创作与策展模型。研究发现，虽然AI辅助作品会稀释训练数据创作者的收益，但产权配置可恢复效率；然而AI替代人类判断内容会导致训练数据质量下降，并扭曲作品相对排名，且由于人类判断作为策展副产品无法定价，难以通过税收或产权解决。

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于内容创作与策展的经济学模型，结合产权理论、信息经济学和副产品外部性分析。
AI.method: 理论建模与均衡分析。

title: Framing Moves the Paradox: Concrete Numbers Attenuate the Allais Certainty Effect

detail.title: Framing Moves the Paradox: Concrete Numbers Attenuate the Allais Certainty Effect

contentType.other: It is an original work not yet published.

detail.abstract: We replicate the two classic choices of the Allais paradox in a randomized survey that manipulates only the framing of the probabilities: one group saw them as percentages, the other as outcomes of a two-digit lottery draw (00-99). The paradoxical pattern appears in full force under the percentage framing but is markedly attenuated when the same probabilities are presented as identifiable numeric events. The shift in preference for the safe option between Problem 1 and Problem 2 is-39 percentage points under percentages versus-12 under numbers; the difference between the two shifts is significant (difference-indifferences z = 2.34, p = 0.019; logistic interaction p = 0.032). We read the result through regret theory and through the certainty-vszero-aversion debate: making the states of the world identifiable changes both the anticipated regret attached to each option and the salience of the zero outcome, and thereby the strength of the certainty effect that sustains the paradox. We discuss the direction of the effect, competing accounts (probability weighting, event-splitting, and aversion to zero), and a design capable of isolating the mechanism.

AI.method: 随机调查实验，操纵概率呈现方式：一组看到百分比，另一组看到两位数抽签结果（00-99）。采用双重差分分析和逻辑回归检验组间差异。
AI.findings: 百分比框架下问题1到问题2向安全选项的偏好转移为-39个百分点，数字框架下仅为-12个百分点，两者差异显著（双重差分z=2.34, p=0.019; 逻辑交互项p=0.032）。数字框架显著削弱了阿莱悖论效应。
