AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为实验设计和调查问卷中概率呈现方式的选择提供了实证参考；2. 有助于理解现实决策中（如金融投资、保险选择）概率表述如何影响风险偏好；3. 为政策制定者设计决策沟通策略提供依据。

title: Race-Conscious Data: The New Political Taxonomy

detail.title: Race-Conscious Data: The New Political Taxonomy
detail.abstract:
Well before the Court issued Students for Fair Admissions, archconservatives broadcast far more ambitious plans to dismantle the building blocks of race consciousness. The second Trump Administration now levies once-fringe demands: that employers abandon racial data collection, disparate impact doctrine, and even voluntary inquiries about racial self-identification. Such attempts to suppress information about race undermine our ability to redress its harms and the bedrock status of race consciousness within a democracy. 

This Article is the first to demonstrate how informational norms have assumed a crucial role in instantiating—or resisting—"colorblindness" in the Trump Era. Through a conceptual integration of race studies, information science, and law, this Article reinterprets the legal frameworks governing information about racial identity. It introduces the term race-conscious data to refer to information that permits society to communicate racial identity, regardless of whether it is digitized. The Article then advances a new taxonomy of ideological positions regarding racial data gleaned from legal, social movement, and lay sources: (1) Liberal Data Guardians; (2) Race-Conscious Dignitarians; (3) Colorblind Regressives; (4) Libertarians; (5) Techno-Authoritarians; and (6) White Nationalists. A modernized taxonomy captures the full range of thought and rhetoric beyond right/left typologies in regulatory choices and their ideological assumptions. 

Posing the question of race-conscious data to ideological formations uncovers the racial functions of competing legal claims. It reveals descriptive and normative values, particularly when race-silencing is selectively applied to spaces that confer material benefits of citizenship to  non-whites. Workplaces and other fora for racial dialogue illustrate the compelling legal and practical barriers to a federal “colorblind” regime. Labor’s particular relationship with conceptualizing material harm will prove crucial in helping society navigate beyond abstraction ad absurdum. It remains possible to chart future policies addressing race, inequality, and law. As before, multilevel conceptual frameworks fill a vacuum in today’s debates over data’s functions as potentially beneficial, exploitative, or otherwise harmful.

AI.tldr: 本文首次揭示信息规范如何在特朗普时代的关键角色——通过构建"种族意识数据"概念并提出六种意识形态立场的全新分类法，论证压制种族信息将破坏民主社会中种族意识的基础地位，并以劳动领域为例说明联邦"色盲"制度面临的现实障碍。
AI.research_question: 在特朗普时代，信息规范如何被用来推行或抵制"色盲"（colorblindness）意识形态？不同的意识形态立场如何看待种族数据的收集、使用与压制？
AI.motivation: 在"公平入学"案之前，极右翼就已谋划拆除种族意识的基石；特朗普第二届政府进一步提出消灭种族数据收集、差别影响理论乃至自愿种族自我认同等激进要求。这些压制种族信息的行为削弱了社会纠正种族伤害的能力，亟需从信息规范的视角进行系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合种族研究、信息科学和法学三大领域，重新诠释关于种族身份信息的法律框架。核心概念为"种族意识数据"（race-conscious data），即允许社会传递种族身份的信息（无论是否数字化）。
AI.method: 概念整合与分类法构建——从法律、社会运动和普通民众来源中提炼出六种关于种族数据的意识形态立场，形成超越传统左右翼划分的现代分类学。
AI.findings: 六种意识形态立场：（1）自由派数据守护者；（2）种族意识尊严派；（3）色盲倒退派；（4）自由意志派；（5）技术威权派；（6）白人至上派。揭示出种族沉默被选择性地应用于非白人群体获取公民物质利益的空间。劳动领域因其与物质损害的独特关系，为帮助社会超越抽象争论提供关键视角。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在学术上将信息规范在"色盲"意识形态中的作用理论化；提出"种族意识数据"概念；构建六分类法超越传统左右翼二元对立，揭示不同法律主张的种族功能及其描述性与规范性价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于种族数据的多层级概念框架，帮助识别数据的有益、剥削或有害功能；论证劳动领域对物质损害的概念化可作为抵制联邦"色盲"制度的关键实践阵地。

title: Active Governance in the Age of Passive Institutions
affiliations: University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill - Finance Area, University of Virginia - McIntire School of Commerce and

detail.title: Active Governance in the Age of Passive Institutions
detail.abstract: Hedge fund activism has become a central market-based mechanism for disciplining public-company managers as equity ownership shifts toward passive institutions that rarely initiate engagement. We review two decades of evidence through a cost-benefit framework that organizes which firms get targeted, when campaigns escalate, and how campaign costs shape activist returns. Activism produces durable shareholder gains and real operating improvements, supported by a coalition in which passive investors prove reliable supporters of campaigns launched by others. Crucially, the discipline extends to firms never targeted. Policy evaluations that count only direct effects at targeted firms systematically understate the cost of constraining activism.

AI.tldr: 本文通过成本-收益框架回顾了两十年对冲基金激进主义（股东积极主义）的证据，分析了哪些公司被盯上、运动如何升级、成本如何影响收益。研究发现激进主义带来持续的股东收益和经营改善，被动投资者是可靠的支持者。更重要的是，这种约束力延伸到未被盯上的公司，因此仅评估直接效应的政策分析会严重低估限制激进主义的成本。
AI.research_question: 对冲基金激进主义如何通过成本-收益机制影响目标公司及非目标公司的治理与绩效？仅关注直接效应的政策评估是否存在系统性低估？
AI.motivation: 随着股权所有权转向很少主动参与的被动机构，对冲基金激进主义已成为约束上市公司管理者的核心市场化机制。作者希望系统回顾证据，并纠正政策评估中的偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成本-收益分析框架，用于解释目标选择、运动升级决策和激进主义收益。理论认为激进主义的约束力不仅限于目标公司，还通过威慑效应延伸至整个市场。
AI.method: 文献综述与成本-收益框架分析，综合两十年间的实证研究证据。
AI.findings: 1）激进主义能为股东带来持续收益并改善公司经营；2）被动投资者是激进运动的关键支持者；3）约束力延伸至从未被盯上的公司，产生广泛的威慑效应；4）仅计算直接效应的政策评估会低估限制激进主义的成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）系统整合了成本-收益框架，将目标选择、运动升级和收益形成统一解释；2）强调了激进主义的间接威慑效应，拓展了治理机制的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者提供了更全面的成本-收益视角，提示评估激进主义监管时应考虑间接效应；2）帮助投资者理解激进主义的收益来源及被动投资者的角色；3）为管理者理解市场约束机制提供参考。

title: Framework Agreements and Territorial Concentration in Chile

detail.title: Framework Agreements and Territorial Concentration in Chile
detail.abstract: Chile requires public entities to consult a centralized framework-agreement catalog (Convenio Marco, CM) before other procedures. From open contracting records on 4.9 million award processes, we build the origin-destination matrix of award-supplier pairs across Chile's sixteen regions and compare the CM channel against the remaining procedures. Catalog purchasing concentrates far more in the Metropolitan Region (RM): in contestable goods, 71-79 percent of CM pairs go to RM-domiciled suppliers against 55-56 percent of non-CM pairs (2022-2025). Buyer-clustered bootstrap intervals exclude zero every year; the difference persists within the same purchasing unit (+9 to +15 points) and within matched buyer-year-class strata (+18.9 [+16.3, +21.1]). Pooled point estimates fall steeply with supplier size-33-36 points for microenterprises, near zero for large firms-and the micro-large contrast is robust under buyer-and supplier-clustered inference. Among non-RM buyers, the catalog shifts 23 points of award relationships from own region to the capital.

AI.tldr: 本文利用智利490万项公开采购记录，比较集中式框架协议目录（CM）与其他采购程序的地理分布差异，发现CM渠道显著倾向于将合同授予首都圣地亚哥（大都会区）的供应商，这种偏向对小微企业尤为突出，并导致非首都买家将大量采购关系从本地转向首都。
AI.research_question: 集中式框架协议目录（CM）采购渠道是否比传统采购程序更倾向于将公共采购合同集中到首都地区的供应商？这种地理集中效应在不同规模供应商和不同地区买家之间有何差异？
AI.motivation: 公共采购是政府支出的重要组成部分，集中式采购框架旨在提高效率，但可能无意中加剧经济地理集中。智利作为高度中央集权的国家，理解不同采购程序对区域经济平衡的影响具有重要的政策含义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于采购程序差异对供应商地理分布影响的分析框架，涉及集中式采购的经济地理效应、公共采购市场准入理论、以及供应商规模异质性对采购地理模式的影响。
AI.method: 利用智利490万项公开采购记录，构建跨16个大区的采购方-供应商配对起点-终点矩阵，通过买家聚类自助法、同一采购单位内比较、匹配买家-年份-品类层级的比较等因果推断方法，分析CM渠道与非CM渠道的地理分布差异。
AI.findings: CM渠道采购高度集中于大都会区（RM）：在可竞争品中，71-79%的CM配对流向RM供应商，而非CM渠道仅55-56%（2022-2025年）；差异在同一采购单位内仍存在（+9至+15个百分点）；差异随供应商规模显著递减——小微企业差33-36个百分点，大企业接近零；对非RM买家，CM将23%的采购关系从本地转向首都。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统量化了集中式框架协议采购程序对公共采购地理集中效应的影响，揭示了采购程序设计作为塑造经济地理的隐性机制，并发现了供应商规模在这一过程中的异质性调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实证依据，表明集中式采购框架虽追求效率，但可能加剧区域经济不平衡；建议在优化采购程序时考虑区域经济平衡目标，特别是保护小微企业参与地方采购的机会，并调整框架协议目录设计以减轻首都偏向效应。

title: Granular Monetary Policy Surprises
affiliations: , Deutsche Bundesbank and Deutsche Bundesbank - Research Centre

detail.title: Granular Monetary Policy Surprises
detail.abstract: Monetary policy shocks are typically measured as a single surprise common to all banks. We construct bank-specific monetary policy surprises from transaction-level OIS data around ECB Governing Council meetings and show that this homogeneity assumption is violated. When aggregated, our measures closely track established euro area surprise series, but at the bank level they reveal substantial within-day dispersion. We validate the economic content of these surprises by showing that banks experiencing larger unexpected policy moves incur significant proprietary stock trading losses, while observable bank characteristics do not predict the surprises. The bank-time variation in our measure enables Khwaja-Mian identification within local projections. For deposit rates, this yields a positive and precisely estimated pass-through. For loan rates, conventional aggregate estimates overstate average pass-through: in the pooled Khwaja-Mian specification, the within-firm average response becomes statistically insignificant. At the same time, loan rate pass-through remains positive and significant for small firms, but not for large firms, even when the borrowing firm is held fixed. This distinction is important because it shows that stronger transmission to small firms cannot be attributed to weaker substitution possibilities alone: even for the same borrower, banks differentially reprice credit in response to monetary policy surprises.

AI.tldr: 本文利用交易层面的OIS数据构建银行层面的货币政策冲击，发现传统假设（所有银行面临相同的货币政策冲击）被违反。银行间存在显著的日内冲击异质性，且这种异质性会导致银行自营股票交易损失。利用银行-时间变动的冲击，结合Khwaja-Mian识别方法，发现存款利率传导为正且精确，但贷款利率的加总估计会高估平均传导系数；在控制企业固定效应后，小企业的贷款利率传导仍显著，大企业则不显著。
AI.research_question: 货币政策冲击在银行层面是否具有异质性？这种异质性如何影响利率传导的估计？
AI.motivation: 传统文献假设货币政策冲击对所有银行是同质的，但这一假设可能不成立。银行层面的冲击异质性会影响货币政策传导的识别，特别是涉及银行-企业匹配的内生性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币政策冲击测度理论、利率传导理论、Khwaja-Mian识别方法、局部投影法（Local Projections）
AI.method: 从交易层面的OIS数据中构建银行层面的货币政策冲击；利用Khwaja-Mian识别方法在局部投影框架内估计利率传导。
AI.findings: （1）银行间存在显著的日内货币政策冲击异质性；（2）冲击较大的银行产生自营股票交易损失；（3）存款利率传导为正且精确；（4）加总估计高估贷款利率平均传导系数；（5）控制企业固定效应后，小企业贷款利率传导仍显著，大企业不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了货币政策冲击同质性的传统假设，提出并验证了银行层面冲击异质性的存在；在货币政策传导领域引入Khwaja-Mian识别方法，解决了银行-企业匹配的内生性问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行和监管机构提供银行层面货币政策冲击的测度方法；揭示了传统加总估计可能高估贷款利率传导的政策含义；强调货币政策对小型企业贷款定价的更强传导效应。

title: Vague by Design: Central Bank Communication with an Inattentive Public
affiliations: and University of Mannheim - Department of Economics

detail.title: Vague by Design: Central Bank Communication with an Inattentive Public
detail.abstract: What is the optimal communication policy for a central bank to inform an inattentive public? We develop a model of central bank communication within a Bayesian persuasion framework, incorporating information processing costs and heterogeneous attention budgets across individuals. The central bank seeks to stabilize the economy by managing inflation expectations in response to fundamental shocks. When the shock is larger than the policy response, it is optimal for the central bank to remain deliberately vague, leveraging inflation surprises to mitigate fluctuations in unemployment. When the shock is smaller than the policy response, the central bank communicates precisely, balancing accuracy against audience reach. We further examine how belief heterogeneity, the share of inattentive individuals, adaptive expectations, and skewed attention budget distributions influence the central bank's optimal communication. Our findings underscore its strategic role as an effective instrument for macroeconomic stabilization.

AI.tldr: 本文研究央行在与不关注信息的公众沟通时，如何通过模糊或精确的沟通策略来最优地稳定经济，发现当冲击大于政策响应时，央行应故意模糊；当冲击小于政策响应时，则应精确沟通。
AI.research_question: 央行面对注意力有限的公众时，最优的沟通政策是什么？
AI.motivation: 现实中公众对央行信息的关注度有限且异质性高，央行沟通如何影响通胀预期和宏观经济稳定是一个重要但尚未充分研究的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯说服（Bayesian persuasion）框架，结合信息处理成本和异质性注意力预算。
AI.method: 理论建模与数学推导。
AI.findings: 当基本面冲击大于政策响应时，央行应保持模糊，利用通胀意外来缓解失业波动；当冲击小于政策响应时，央行应精确沟通。信念异质性、不关注公众比例、适应性预期和注意力预算分布均影响最优沟通策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 将注意力约束和异质性公众纳入贝叶斯说服框架，拓展了央行沟通的宏观稳定理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行在不同经济环境下选择模糊或精确的沟通策略提供了理论依据，强调沟通作为宏观经济稳定工具的战略价值。

title: The Analytical Turn in Corporate Taxation: Multi-Jurisdictional Data Reconstruction After Wayfair and Pillar Two

detail.title: The Analytical Turn in Corporate Taxation: Multi-Jurisdictional Data Reconstruction After Wayfair and Pillar Two
detail.abstract: United States corporate tax management faces severe operational strain driven by multijurisdictional statutory changes and a tightening licensure pipeline for certified public accountants (CPAs). Following South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc. (2018), state sales tax compliance fragmented across over 10,000 local tax jurisdictions (Wayfair, 585 U.S. at 203 (Roberts, C.J., dissenting)) with conflicting economic nexus thresholds, measurement windows, and rule updates. Concurrently, multinational entities face OECD Pillar Two global minimum tax mandates, including compliance with the January 5, 2026 Side-by-Side framework, that require continuous tracking across inconsistent international accounting rules. While U.S. accounting program enrollments recovered to 266,506 in 2025, the professional licensure pipeline faces a structural bottleneck: first-time CPA exam candidate volume fell to 28,082 in 2024, creating acute capacity constraints for tax practices facing 124,200 annual openings, which are largely driven by replacement needs. Tax functions cannot solve these compliance burdens through entry-level recruitment alone. Instead, corporate tax departments and independent tax consultants must adopt data reconstruction, an analytical methodology that normalizes, cleanses, and reconciles multiyear general ledger records into standardized reporting structures. Utilizing low-code data transformation tools alongside interactive visual analytics, tax practitioners can identify hidden multi-year exposures, optimize compliance operations, and automate multi-jurisdictional risk tracking.

AI.tldr: 美国企业税务管理面临多司法管辖区税法变化和CPA人才短缺的双重压力，提出数据重构方法（利用低代码工具和可视化分析）作为解决方案，以标准化多年度总账数据、优化合规运营并自动化多司法管辖区风险追踪。
AI.research_question: 在美国税法碎片化（Wayfair案后超1万个地方税务辖区）和国际税收规则（OECD Pillar Two全球最低税）双重压力下，以及CPA人才管道结构性瓶颈（2024年首考人数仅28,082人，而年均岗位空缺124,200个）的背景下，企业税务部门如何有效应对合规负担？
AI.motivation: 企业税务管理面临前所未有的运营压力：一方面，Wayfair案导致州销售税合规碎片化（超1万个税区，经济关联门槛冲突）；另一方面，OECD Pillar Two全球最低税规则要求持续追踪不一致的国际会计准则。同时，CPA人才管道出现结构性瓶颈（2024年首考人数降至28,082，而年均需填补124,200个岗位），传统靠招聘初级人员的策略已不可行。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据重构方法论（data reconstruction）：一种将多年度总账记录标准化、清洗、对账的分析方法，整合低代码数据转换工具与交互式可视化分析，用于发现隐藏的多年度税务暴露、优化合规运营并自动化多司法管辖区风险追踪。
AI.method: 概念性方法论提出，结合低代码数据转换工具与交互式可视化分析技术，构建数据重构框架以应对多司法管辖区税务合规挑战。
AI.findings: 1. 美国税务合规环境高度碎片化：Wayfair案后超1万个地方税区，经济关联门槛和测量窗口冲突。2. CPA人才管道存在结构性瓶颈：2024年首考仅28,082人，远低于年均124,200个岗位空缺。3. 传统通过招聘初级人员解决合规负担的策略失效。4. 数据重构方法可作为替代方案，通过低代码工具和可视化分析实现隐藏风险识别、合规优化和自动化风险追踪。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了数据重构（data reconstruction）作为一种应对多司法管辖区税务合规的系统性方法论框架，将低代码技术与可视化分析整合到税务管理领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业税务部门和独立税务顾问提供了可操作的数据重构方法论，包括利用低代码数据转换工具和交互式可视化分析来标准化总账数据、发现隐藏的多年风险暴露、优化合规运营并实现多司法管辖区风险自动化追踪，从而缓解人才瓶颈带来的运营压力。

title: A Coupled Framework for Macroeconomic Dynamics: Application to Adaptive Learning

detail.title: A Coupled Framework for Macroeconomic Dynamics: Application to Adaptive Learning
detail.abstract: This paper proposes a framework for macroeconomic dynamics in which individual optimization and aggregate adjustment are coupled. Recursive household optimization generates a canonical Hamiltonian system in states and costates, while aggregate state variables evolve through a dissipative process that descends an economic potential. The resulting system takes the form ż = J∇ H-M∇ F. Adaptive learning provides the first basic application of this structure. Under anticipated utility, households optimize under their current perceived law of motion for returns without forecasting their own future belief revisions. The economy then generates realized outcomes, and common beliefs adjust in response to forecast errors. In a deterministic growth economy, the joint rest point is a self-confirming competitive equilibrium. When the perceived family is correct state-by-state and learning becomes arbitrarily fast, the rational-expectations consistency condition is recovered. The contribution is the underlying modeling architecture. Adaptive learning is one instance of a broader decomposition that preserves recursive individual optimization while giving aggregate states their own dynamics, providing a foundation for future models of richer belief processes and nonlinear aggregate transitions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种宏观经济学动态框架，将个体递归优化与总体状态变量的耗散演化耦合，形成"ż = J∇H - M∇F"的广义哈密顿系统，以适应性学习为例展示了该架构如何统一理性预期与非均衡调整过程。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个既能保留递归个体优化、又能赋予总体状态变量独立动力学的宏观动态建模架构？
AI.motivation: 现有宏观模型要么完全依赖理性预期均衡（个体优化与总体一致性同时实现），要么缺乏严格的微观基础。本文试图提供一种介于两者之间的建模架构，使个体优化与总体调整过程可以耦合但不必同时满足均衡条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 哈密顿系统（Hamiltonian system）、耗散过程（dissipative process）、经济势（economic potential）、自我确认均衡（self-confirming equilibrium）、理性预期一致性条件
AI.method: 理论建模：将递归家庭优化与总体状态变量演化耦合，导出广义动力系统形式ż = J∇H - M∇F；以适应性学习（anticipated utility）作为具体应用案例进行分析。
AI.findings: 1. 递归个体优化生成典范的哈密顿系统（状态与协状态）；2. 总体变量通过耗散过程沿经济势下降方向演化；3. 在确定性增长经济中，联合不动点是自我确认竞争均衡；4. 当感知模型逐状态正确且学习速度趋于无穷时，恢复理性预期一致性条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了一种统一建模架构，将个体优化（哈密顿结构）与总体非均衡调整（耗散动力学）有机结合；2. 证明了适应性学习是该架构的一个特例，为未来更丰富的信念过程和非线性总体转型模型提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为宏观经济学建模提供了新的技术范式，允许研究者构建个体理性但总体非均衡的动态模型，有助于分析经济政策在过渡路径上的效应，以及理解非理性预期如何影响宏观经济动态。

title: Municipal Viability in Bolivia

detail.title: Municipal Viability in Bolivia
detail.abstract: This paper develops an updated diagnostic framework to assess municipal viability in Bolivia and identifies the main territorial constraints that limit it. The analysis retains a six-dimensional conception of viability—fiscal, administrative, demographic, economic, service, and human capital conditions—while refining key criteria to improve analytical precision and policy relevance. In particular, the administrative criterion is strengthened by incorporating the operations and maintenance (O&M) share, and the demographic criterion is reformulated to combine scale or compactness with demographic dynamism. Results show that only a minority of municipalities meet the minimum viability conditions, while an even smaller group meets the enhanced viability conditions. Fiscal viability emerges as the most severe bottleneck, followed by human capital, basic services, and demographic viability. A central finding is that demographic dynamism, rather than size alone, emerges as the more restrictive condition for territorial viability. The paper also integrates this individual municipal diagnosis with a companion system-level perspective developed elsewhere, showing that the same phenomenon can be understood both as a territorial distribution of constraints and as a developmental mechanism linking fiscal effort, services, and outcomes. Taken together, both perspectives suggest that decentralization policy in Bolivia requires differentiated interventions: system-level incentive reforms and targeted support tailored to municipalities' specific deficits. The framework is intended both as a diagnostic tool and a basis for future policy design.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一套更新后的诊断框架，用于评估玻利维亚城市的可持续性，识别了限制城市发展的主要领土约束，并发现财政可持续性是最严重的瓶颈，人口活力（而非城市规模）是更严格的限制条件。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个更精确的诊断框架来评估玻利维亚城市的可持续性？哪些领土约束是限制城市发展的关键瓶颈？
AI.motivation: 现有城市可持续性评估框架在分析精度和政策相关性上存在不足，需要更新标准，尤其是行政和人口维度，以更准确地识别玻利维亚城市面临的具体约束。
AI.theoretical_framework: 六维度可持续性框架：财政、行政、人口、经济、服务、人力资本条件；同时结合系统层面的发展机制分析。
AI.method: 构建更新的诊断框架，纳入运维支出占比（O&M share）强化行政标准，结合规模/紧凑度与人口活力重新定义人口标准，对玻利维亚各城市进行实证评估。
AI.findings: 仅少数城市达到最低可持续条件，更少城市达到增强条件；财政可持续性是最严重瓶颈，其次是人力资本、基本服务和人口可持续性；人口活力（而非规模）是更严格的限制条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 将城市可持续性诊断从静态的规模视角扩展为动态的人口活力视角，同时整合个体诊断与系统层面分析，构建了约束分布与发展机制的双重视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为玻利维亚的分权政策提供了差异化干预建议：系统层面的激励改革与针对特定城市缺陷的定向支持相结合；框架可作为诊断工具和未来政策设计的基础。

title: The Costs of Highways on Isolated Communities: Evidence from the Alaska Highway

detail.title: The Costs of Highways on Isolated Communities: Evidence from the Alaska Highway
detail.abstract: This paper provides evidence that highway construction in remote areas can have detrimental effects on isolated communities. I leverage as a natural experiment the construction of the Alaska Highway, which was built in 1942 to better protect Alaska from Japanese attack through improving its access to the continental United States. The highway's path was dictated purely by military considerations, which implies that its proximity to communities was plausibly random. I digitize several alternative routes and use communities near these routes as the control group, further strengthening the case for my estimates being causal. My empirical analysis suggests that the Alaska Highway led to large decreases in populations for nearby Indigenous communities, with losses being particularly concentrated amongst very young children, particularly boys. I present further corroborating pieces of evidence, including results using death and marriage records for British Columbia, which most strongly support reduced fertility as the channel through which the population declines in aggregate operate.

AI.tldr: 本研究发现，1942年阿拉斯加高速公路的建设对沿线偏远土著社区造成了显著的人口下降，尤其是幼年男孩数量减少，主要机制是生育率下降。
AI.research_question: 在偏远地区修建高速公路是否会对当地孤立社区产生负面影响？
AI.motivation: 尽管交通基础设施通常被认为促进经济发展，但偏远地区的高速公路可能反而对孤立社区带来负面影响。本文利用阿拉斯加高速公路建设这一自然实验来检验这一假设。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基础设施建设对偏远社区影响的理论；准自然实验与因果识别方法。
AI.method: 以阿拉斯加高速公路建设为准自然实验（1942年因军事目的修建，路径由军事考量决定，具有外生性）。通过数字化多条替代路线，将替代路线附近的社区作为对照组，采用因果推断方法进行估计。
AI.findings: 阿拉斯加高速公路导致附近土著社区人口大幅下降，人口损失集中于非常年幼的儿童，尤其是男孩。进一步的证据（不列颠哥伦比亚省的死亡和婚姻记录）支持生育率下降是人口下降的主要渠道。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"交通基础设施必然促进发展"的传统观点，揭示了在特定情境下基础设施可能对孤立社区产生负面影响。为基建与人口变迁的关系提供了新的因果证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为偏远地区交通基础设施建设政策提供重要警示：高速公路建设可能对孤立社区造成意外的人口负面影响，政策制定需考虑对脆弱社区的保护措施。

title: The Mechanization of Manufacturing and Female Labour in the 19th Century United States: Evidence from Establishment-Level Panel Data

detail.title: The Mechanization of Manufacturing and Female Labour in the 19th Century United States: Evidence from Establishment-Level Panel Data
detail.abstract: I study the effects of mechanization on the size, composition, and earnings of the workforces of establishments in the 19th century United States using two data sources. The first is an establishment-level dataset with a panel component that contains rich information on over 1000 establishments' employment and composition for its workforce, disaggregated by occupation, age, and gender. I construct measures of mechanization by industry using a Department of Labor report on labour savings through mechanization in manufacturing by product. Crucially, the detailed tables include labour time used from hand versus machine methods by male versus female labour; this allows me to construct overall measures of labour savings through mechanization as well as savings in female labour. I find that establishments in industries where female labour savings from mechanization were greater increased their use of all labour, but particularly female labour. In contrast, I do not find similar effects for mechanization more broadly. Conversely, I find that overall mechanization increased earnings but not for female or child workers while female-specific mechanization had little effect on earnings. I rationalize these findings with qualitative evidence that shows that these establishments valued female labour principally for their adaptability and lower cost.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了19世纪美国机械化对工厂劳动力规模、构成和收入的影响，发现节省女性劳动力的机械化显著增加了女性雇佣，但未提升其工资。
AI.research_question: 19世纪美国机械化如何影响工厂的劳动力规模、构成（按性别、年龄划分）以及员工的收入水平？
AI.motivation: 现有研究对机械化影响劳动力的机制尚不清晰，特别是机械化对不同性别劳动力的差异化影响缺乏实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力需求理论、性别分工理论、技术偏向性变革理论。
AI.method: 使用19世纪美国超过1000家工厂的微观面板数据，结合劳工部关于机械化节省劳动力的行业报告，构建总体和女性劳动力节省指标，进行计量分析。
AI.findings: （1）节省女性劳动力的机械化显著增加了女性雇佣总量；但（2）总体机械化水平提高收入，却未提高女性和童工收入；（3）女性专用的机械化对收入影响很小。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了技术变革中女性劳动力的替代与互补效应并存，深化了对历史时期性别化技术冲击的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解技术变革对不同性别劳动力的差异化影响提供历史证据，对当前自动化和AI对就业影响的政策制定有借鉴意义。
